title: RULES AND REGULATIONS GOVERNING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE FREE TRADE AGREEMENT (FTA) ORIGIN MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (OMS), INCLUDING THE PRODUCT EVALUATION REPORT (PER) MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (PMS), IN THE PHILIPPINES
subject: Online application at processing ng Product Evaluation Report (PER) gamit ang FTA OMS at PMS
effectivity: This Order shall take effect immediately.
related: Rule 1, Paragraph (c), Annex 4-A, Operational Certification Procedures for the Rules of Origin under Chapter 4, PH-KR FTA

ai.title: CMO 06-2025: FTA OMS at PMS para sa PER
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CMO 06-2025 ang nagtatakda ng patakaran sa online na pag-apply at pagproseso ng Product Evaluation Report (PER) gamit ang FTA Origin Management System (OMS) at PER Management System (PMS), para makuha ng exporters ang preferential tariff treatment sa ilalim ng mga FTA at GSP.

🔍 Breakdown: Sec. 1 Scope (anong FTAs at GSPs ang sakop). Sec. 2 Objectives. Sec. 3 Definition of Terms (ECD, PER, OMS, PMS, PSR, ROO at iba pa). Sec. 4 General Provisions (roles ng DTI at BOC, registration sa OMS at PMS). Sec. 5 Operational Provisions (hakbang sa PER application, evaluation, plant visit, approval, 20 working days). Sec. 6 Monitoring (dashboards at buwanang report). Sec. 7 hanggang 10: manual option, separability, repealing, effectivity.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Online na ang proseso. Mag-create ng account sa OMS, mag-upload ng documents, tapos ang BOC Evaluator at Approver ang magre-review sa PMS. May electronic reference number para ma-track ang application.

📦 Halimbawa: Isang dried mango exporter sa Cebu ang gustong magpadala sa Japan sa ilalim ng PJEPA. Nag-register siya sa OMS, in-upload ang company profile, manufacturing flowchart at cost of production analysis, at nakakuha ng electronic reference number. Pagkatapos ng evaluation ng BOC, dinownload niya ang approved PER at saka nag-apply ng Certificate of Origin.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Ang PER ang unang hakbang para ma-establish na originating goods ang produkto, kaya ito ang daan para sa preferential tariff treatment.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 20 working days ang processing period. DTI ang may hosting ng OMS at PMS, pero BOC ang may administration ng PMS. May option pa ring mag-submit nang manual (Sec. 7). Preliminary lang ang OMS determination.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: Memorize ang hatian ng roles (DTI vs BOC), ang documentary requirements (a hanggang g), ang 20 working days, at ang report tuwing 'every fifth day' ng BOC sa DTI-EMB.

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Tanong: Final na ba ang resulta ng OMS pre-evaluation? Sagot: Hindi. Preliminary lang ito at puwedeng iba sa findings ng Evaluator at sa review ng Approver.

🔗 Related Topics: CMTA Sec. 503, CMO 11-2024, RA 11032, Revised Kyoto Convention, Rules of Origin, Operational Certification Procedures.

paragraphs.text: This Order implements Section 503, Chapter 1, Title V of Republic Act 10863, otherwise known as the Customs Modernization and Tariff Act (CMTA), in line with the commitments of the Philippines to the Revised Kyoto Convention (RKC), preferential trade arrangements and other relevant international agreements.

ai.title: Legal Basis
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sinasabi rito na ang CMO ay pagpapatupad ng Sec. 503 ng CMTA (RA 10863) at alinsunod sa commitments ng Pilipinas sa RKC at sa mga preferential trade arrangements.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May batas at international commitment na pinagbabatayan ang CMO na ito, hindi ito basta bagong patakaran lang.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tatlong anchor ang Introduction: CMTA Sec. 503, RKC, at preferential trade agreements.

paragraphs.text: This Order shall cover the procedures for the online application, submission and processing of Product Evaluation Report (PER) in accordance with the respective Operational Certification Procedures (OCP) on Rules of Origin of Generalized System of Preferences (GSPs) and of the following Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) , using the FTA Origin Management System (OMS) including the PER Management System (PMS):

ai.title: Saklaw ng Order
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sakop ng Order ang online application, submission at processing ng PER ayon sa OCP on Rules of Origin ng GSPs at ng mga nakalistang FTAs, gamit ang OMS at PMS.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang sagot sa tanong na 'kanino at saan ito ina-apply?' Lahat ng PER application para sa GSP at sa FTAs sa listahan ay dadaan sa OMS.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang OMS ang portal ng application, at ang PMS ang sistema ng BOC para i-process ito.

paragraphs.text: Generalized System of Preference (GSP) – shall refer to a unilateral scheme wherein custom duty preferences or concessions are granted by developed countries.

ai.title: Generalized System of Preference (GSP)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang GSP ay unilateral na scheme kung saan ang developed countries ang nagbibigay ng customs duty preferences o concessions.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang importing developed country ang kusang nagbibigay ng bawas o exemption sa duty, hindi ito dalawang-panig na negosasyon tulad ng FTA.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang keyword ay 'unilateral'. Kaibang-kaiba ito sa FTA na bilateral o multilateral.

paragraphs.text: Origin Management System (OMS) – shall refer to the online Portal which digitalizes the entire process of managing basic information of exporting companies to the application and issuance of PER.

ai.title: Origin Management System (OMS)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang OMS ay online Portal na nagdi-digitalize ng buong proseso ng pag-manage ng basic information ng exporting companies hanggang sa application at issuance ng PER.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: OMS ay para sa exporter side. PMS ay para sa BOC side. Hosted ito ng DTI (4.1.1).

paragraphs.text: Originating Goods – shall refer to a good that qualifies as an originating good in accordance with the Rules of Origin (ROO) under the respective Agreements or GSPs.

ai.title: Originating Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang good na pumapasa bilang originating good ayon sa Rules of Origin (ROO) ng kaukulang Agreement o GSP.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kailangang pasado ang produkto sa ROO bago ito makakuha ng preferential tariff.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang ROO ng bawat Agreement o GSP ang batayan, kaya puwedeng magkaiba ang resulta depende sa agreement.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Para lang ito sa originating goods. Hindi lahat ng exported goods ay nakakakuha nito.

paragraphs.text: Product Evaluation Report (PER) - shall refer to a document issued to applicants that contains the result of the evaluation on export products after complying with the requirements of the Bureau.

ai.title: Product Evaluation Report (PER)

paragraphs.text: PER Management System (PMS) – shall refer to a web-based platform which is integrated with the OMS and designed to automate the processing and approval of PER applications by the Bureau's authorized personnel.

title: IMPLEMENTATION OF THE ELECTRONIC PAYMENT PORTAL SYSTEM (ePay) OF THE BUREAU OF CUSTOMS
subject: Implementation of the Electronic Payment Portal System (ePay) for online payment of duties, taxes and miscellaneous fees

ai.title: ePay Implementation (CMO 06-2024)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CMO 06-2024 ang nagpapatupad ng Electronic Payment Portal System (ePay) ng BOC, ang online platform para sa pagbabayad ng duties, taxes at miscellaneous fees gamit ang credit/debit card, digital wallet at iba pang digital payment channels.

🔍 Breakdown: Sec. 1 Scope · Sec. 2 Objectives · Sec. 3 Definition of Terms · Sec. 4 Administrative Provisions (MISTG, accounts, reports) · Sec. 5 Operational Provisions (step-by-step na pag-generate ng OP) · Sec. 6 Exclusions · Sec. 7 Responsibility to Confirm Payment · Sec. 8 Administrative Liability · Sec. 9 Implementation Schedule · Sec. 10 Separability · Sec. 11 Repealing · Annex: User Access Request Form at Terms of Use.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Puwede nang mag-generate ng 'Order of Payment' (OP) online, tapos bayaran via ePay o via cashier. May real-time na confirmation ng payment at available ang user interface 24/7.

📦 Halimbawa: May informal entry na manual na pinroseso. Ang concerned BOC office ay nag-generate ng OP sa ePay, nag-email ang system ng OP Reference Number sa consignee, at binayaran niya ito via e-wallet. Ang OP ay lumabas na 'tagged' bilang paid at nakumpirma ito ng BOC office.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Ito ang implementation ng EO No. 170 s. 2022 sa BOC, kaya malinaw ang proseso ng digital collection, kung sino ang responsible at paano mino-monitor ang collections.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Informal entry (manual) at misc. fees lang ang covered. Excluded ang E2M consumption entries at additional assessments from Post Entry Modification. Ang OP na hindi nabayaran sa validity period ay 'Expired'.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: Memorize kung sino ang maintainer ng ePay (MISTG), sino ang nagre-reconcile (RAD), ano ang 'Fixed Values' at ano ang excluded (E2M).

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Tanong: Sakop ba ng ePay ang entries sa E2M? Sagot: Hindi. Excluded ang consumption entries na filed sa E2M, pati ang additional assessments from Post Entry Modification.

🔗 Related Topics: EO No. 170 s. 2022, informal entry procedure, E2M System, Post Entry Modification, miscellaneous fees, digital payments.

paragraphs.text: This Order shall cover the collection of duties and taxes due on goods covered by goods declaration manually processed under the informal entry procedure and the miscellaneous fees payable to the Bureau using the Electronic Payment Portal System (ePay), which shall be monitored by the Collection Division of the Ports, the Revenue Accounting Division (RAD), the Statistical Analysis Division (STAD) and other concerned offices in the Bureau.

title: GUIDELINES ON THE ISSUANCE OF PROOF OF ORIGIN, GRANTING OF PREFERENTIAL TARIFF TREATMENT UNDER THE PHILIPPINES – KOREA FREE TRADE AGREEMENT (PH-KR FTA)
subject: Proof of origin and preferential tariff treatment under the PH-KR FTA
effectivity: This Order shall take effect on 31 December 2024.

ai.title: Overview: Proof of Origin sa PH-KR FTA
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CMO 11-2024 ang guidelines ng BOC para sa pag-issue ng Proof of Origin at pag-grant ng preferential tariff sa ilalim ng Philippines–Korea Free Trade Agreement.

🔍 Breakdown: Sec. 1–3: Scope, objectives, at definitions. Sec. 4: General at administrative provisions. Sec. 5: Operational procedures (product evaluation, CO, Approved Exporter, Origin Declaration). Sec. 6: Verification. Sec. 7–8: Separability at effectivity.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kung gusto ng importer ng mas mababang duty sa Korean-origin goods, kailangan niya ng valid Proof of Origin: either CO (Form PH-KR) o Origin Declaration mula sa Approved Exporter. Dito nakasulat kung paano makukuha at paano ito vine-verify ng BOC.

📦 Halimbawa: May Korean supplier na nag-export ng electronic components sa Manila. Nag-file ang importer ng entry at nag-attach ng CO Form PH-KR. Ie-evaluate ng PRU kung authentic at valid ito bago ibigay ang PH-KR FTA preferential rate.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Walang valid Proof of Origin, walang preferential rate. Core ito ng FTA claims sa practice at madalas lumabas sa review.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dalawa ang anyo ng Proof of Origin: CO at OD. Ang ECD ang main office na nagpo-process ng applications at verification. Ang PRU ang nag-e-evaluate ng Proof of Origin sa ports.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: Memorize ang mga office (ECD, PRU), ang mga dokumento (CO, OD, PER), at ang mga timeline na nasa Section 5.

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Q: Pareho ba ang CO at OD?
A: Hindi. Ang CO ay issued ng issuing body ng exporting Party; ang OD ay ginagawa ng Approved Exporter mismo.

🔗 Related Topics: CMO 12-2023, PH-KR FTA Chapter 4, Operational Certification Procedures.

title: Guidelines on the Issuance of Proof of Origin, Granting of Preferential Tariff Treatment, and Verification Procedures under the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) Agreement
subject: Pag-isyu ng Proof of Origin, pagbibigay ng RCEP preferential tariff, at verification procedures
effectivity: 02 June 2023, which is the effectivity date of EO No. 25, series of 2023

ai.title: CMO 12-2023: RCEP Proof of Origin, Preferential Tariff, at Verification
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CMO 12-2023 ang guidelines ng Bureau of Customs para ipatupad ang RCEP Agreement sa Pilipinas, ayon sa EO No. 25, s. 2023. Tatlo ang sakop: pag-isyu at pagtanggap ng Proof of Origin (CO at DO), paggamit ng RCEP preferential tariff (kasama ang tariff differentials), at verification procedures.

🔍 Breakdown: Sec. 1 Scope. Sec. 2 Objectives (3 layunin). Sec. 3 Definition of Terms (3.1 hanggang 3.16). Sec. 4 General Provisions: eligibility, tinatanggap na Proof of Origin, refund, at tungkulin ng ECD, AOCG, at PRU. Sec. 5 Operational Provisions: 5.1 PER, 5.2 CO, 5.3 Approved Exporter application, 5.4 obligations ng Approved Exporter, 5.5 DO, 5.6 back-to-back Proof of Origin, 5.7 RCEP Country of Origin, 5.8 import procedures. Sec. 6 Verification: 6.1 imported goods, 6.2 exported goods. Sec. 7 Repealing Clause. Sec. 8 Effectivity. Footnotes 1 hanggang 4.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa RCEP, puwedeng mas mababa ang duty ng produkto kung mapapatunayang originating ito. Ang patunay ay ang Proof of Origin: CO (galing sa issuing body, sa Pilipinas ay ECD o Export Division/Unit) o DO (galing sa Approved Exporter). Ipinapaliwanag ng CMO kung paano ito kukunin sa export side, paano gagamitin ng importer sa import side, at paano ito iche-check ng BOC kapag may duda.

📦 Halimbawa: Isang exporter ng processed food sa Metro Manila ang gustong mag-export sa isang RCEP Party. Mag-a-apply muna siya ng PER sa ECD para ma-evaluate ang produkto, tapos mag-a-apply ng CO Form RCEP. Sa kabilang banda, kung importer naman sa Pilipinas, ipapakita niya ang original Proof of Origin sa PRU para makuha ang RCEP rate. Kapag may reasonable doubt ang PRU, puwede itong mag-request ng verification sa pamamagitan ng ECD.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Ito ang operational guide ng mga exporter, importer, at customs broker para magamit ang RCEP benefits. Ito rin ang nagsasabi kung sino ang may tungkulin (ECD, AOCG, PRU, CCC) at ano ang mga timeline, kaya madalas itong pinagmumulan ng exam questions.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Effectivity: 02 June 2023 (4.2 at Sec. 8). BOC tatanggap lang ng CO Form RCEP at DO ng Approved Exporter (4.2). PER: 21 working days, dagdag 10 working days kung may plant visit (5.1.3). Approved Exporter: 14 working days (5.3.4); kailangan ng at least 1 taon na transaksyon sa BOC at at least 1 taon na pag-e-export sa RCEP Party (5.3.3). Records ng Approved Exporter: at least 3 years (5.4.2). Verification requests: hanggang 3 years pagkatapos ng importation (6.1.1, 6.2.1). Imports: 30 hanggang 90 days para sumagot (6.1.5), 90 hanggang 180 days para magdesisyon (6.1.6), 30 days para pumayag sa visit (6.1.9), visit sa loob ng 60 days at desisyon sa loob ng 30 days (6.1.10). Exports: 30 days para sumagot (6.2.4), resulta sa loob ng 90 days (6.2.5). Annex 1 goods: DV20 (5.7.1.b).

🎯 Board Exam Tip: I-memorize ang mga numero (21+10, 14, 1 year, 3 years, 30 hanggang 90, 90 hanggang 180, 60, 30, 90, DV20) at ang papel ng ECD (export side at verification), AOCG, PRU (import side), at CCC (hard copies at release ng PER at CO). Alamin ang pagkakaiba ng CO (issuing body) at DO (Approved Exporter), at ng 6.1 (imports) at 6.2 (exports).

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Tanong: Puwede bang mag-isyu ng DO ang kahit anong exporter?
Sagot: Hindi pa. Sa ngayon, CO Form RCEP at DO ng Approved Exporter lang ang tatanggapin ng BOC (4.2). Ang DO ng ordinaryong exporter o producer ay tatanggapin lang kapag in-implement na ng Pilipinas ang subparagraph 1(c), Article 3.16 ng RCEP Agreement.

🔗 Related Topics: EO No. 25, s. 2023. CMO 25-2020 (refund at post-importation claims). RCEP Chapter 2 (Art. 2.4, 2.6) at Chapter 3 (Art. 3.2, 3.16, 3.24). Annex 1 (DV20), Annex 2 (application form), Annex 3 (DO), Annex 3B ng RCEP (minimum information).

paragraphs.text: This Order shall govern the implementation of the issuance and acceptance of Proof of Origin, application of the provision on tariff differentials, and verification procedures under the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) Agreement.

ai.title: Scope ng CMO 12-2023
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CMO na ito ang gumagabay sa tatlong bagay sa ilalim ng RCEP Agreement: (1) pag-isyu at pagtanggap ng Proof of Origin, (2) paggamit ng provision sa tariff differentials, at (3) verification procedures.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'table of contents' ng buong Order. Lahat ng susunod na sections ay pasok sa tatlong bucket na iyan: papeles ng origin, tamang rate na ilalapat, at pag-check kung totoo ang origin claim.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: RCEP lang ang sakop ng Order na ito. Kapag may tanong na 'sakop ba ito ng CMO 12-2023?', i-check kung may kinalaman sa Proof of Origin, tariff differentials, o verification sa ilalim ng RCEP.

Sec. 2 (Objectives), Sec. 5 (Operational Provisions), Sec. 6 (Verification)), at linawin ang mga karaniwang maling akala ng students. paragraphs.text: The objectives of this Order are to:

ai.title: Mga Layunin: Intro
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Intro clause ito ng Section 2. Wala pa itong sariling rule; taga-introduce lang ng tatlong layunin ng Order sa 2.1 hanggang 2.3.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa mga CMO, ang 'Objectives' ang nagsasabi ng 'bakit' ginawa ang Order. Kapag nakuha mo ang layunin, mas madali mong maiintindihan kung bakit may PER, CO, DO, at verification sa mga susunod na sections.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tatlo lang ang layunin: (1) i-implement ang Chapter 2 at 3 ng RCEP, (2) maglatag ng procedures sa Proof of Origin at preferential tariff, (3) gumawa ng mekanismo para sa Approved Exporter. Madalas itong lumabas sa 'which is NOT an objective' na tanong.

paragraphs.text: implement Chapter 2 (Trade in Goods)¹ and Chapter 3 (Rules of Origin) of the RCEP Agreement;

ai.title: Layunin: I-implement ang Chapter 2 at 3
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Unang layunin: i-implement sa Pilipinas ang Chapter 2 (Trade in Goods) at Chapter 3 (Rules of Origin) ng RCEP Agreement. Ayon sa Footnote 1, ang sakop dito ay Article 2.4 (Reduction or Elimination of Customs Duties) at Article 2.6 (Tariff Differentials).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang RCEP Agreement ay international treaty. Ang CMO na ito ang nagpapatakbo nito sa level ng BOC: Chapter 2 ang tungkol sa duties, Chapter 3 ang tungkol sa origin rules.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Chapter 2 = Trade in Goods. Chapter 3 = Rules of Origin. Sa Footnote 1 nakasulat na Art. 2.4 at Art. 2.6 lang ng Chapter 2 ang sakop ng Order.

paragraphs.text: provide procedures for the issuance of Proof of Origin and granting of preferential tariff treatment for goods that qualify as originating under the RCEP Agreement, including under tariff differentials, application for refund and post-importation claims; and

ai.title: Layunin: Procedures sa Proof of Origin at Tariff
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ikalawang layunin: maglatag ng procedures sa pag-isyu ng Proof of Origin at pagbibigay ng preferential tariff sa mga produktong qualified bilang originating sa ilalim ng RCEP. Kasama rito ang tariff differentials, application for refund, at post-importation claims.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lang ito tungkol sa pagkuha ng patunay ng origin. Sakop din kung paano makukuha ang tamang rate, at kung paano mababawi ang sobrang nabayaran kapag hindi nakuha ang preferential rate noong importation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Apat na bagay sa layuning ito: Proof of Origin, preferential tariff, tariff differentials, at refund/post-importation claims. Ang refund at post-importation claims ay makikita sa Sec. 4.3 at 4.4.

paragraphs.text: establish a mechanism to accredit exporters as "Approved Exporter" under the RCEP Agreement.

ai.title: Layunin: Approved Exporter
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ikatlong layunin: magtatag ng mekanismo para ma-accredit ang mga exporter bilang 'Approved Exporter' sa ilalim ng RCEP Agreement.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Gumawa ang BOC ng sariling 'accreditation' system para sa mga exporter na puwedeng mag-complete ng sarili nilang Declaration of Origin (DO). Ang buong proseso ng pag-apply ay nasa Sec. 5.3.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Approved Exporter = in-accredit ng BOC. Ang DO ay hindi galing sa gobyerno kundi sa Approved Exporter mismo. Tandaan ang Sec. 5.3 (application) at Sec. 5.4 (obligations).

paragraphs.text: For purposes of this Order, the following terms are defined accordingly:

ai.title: Definition of Terms: Intro
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Intro ito ng Section 3. Dito nakalista ang kahulugan ng mga terminong gagamitin sa buong Order.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag nagbasa ka ng procedures sa Sec. 4, 5, at 6, paulit-ulit lalabas ang mga termino tulad ng PER, DO, CO, PRU, at ECD. Dito mo makukuha ang eksaktong ibig sabihin ng bawat isa, kaya ito ang pundasyon ng buong Order.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: May 16 na terms (3.1 hanggang 3.16): Approved Exporter, Authorization Code, CO, DO, ECD, Exporter, Importer, Originating good, Producer, Production, PER, PRU, Proof of Origin, RCEP Party, ROO, at Tariff Differential. Madalas itong ginagawang identification at matching type sa exam.

paragraphs.text: Approved Exporter – shall refer to an exporter authorized by the Bureau of Customs (BOC) to complete a Declaration of Origin (DO) in accordance with Section 5.5;

ai.title: Approved Exporter
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Exporter na binigyan ng awtorisasyon ng BOC para mag-complete ng Declaration of Origin (DO) ayon sa Sec. 5.5.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Siya ang exporter na pinagkatiwalaan ng BOC mag-self-certify ng origin ng sarili niyang produkto. Ayon sa 3.13, puwedeng DO ng Approved Exporter ang gamiting Proof of Origin imbes na CO.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: BOC ang nagbibigay ng awtorisasyon (Sec. 5.3). DO lang ang kaya niyang i-complete; ang CO ay galing sa issuing body. Hanggang sa mga produktong pinayagan lang ng BOC ang puwede niyang i-declare (5.4.1.b).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Parang 'ID number' ng Approved Exporter. Dahil nasa DO ito at nasa database, may paraan para ma-verify na authorized talaga ang nag-declare.

paragraphs.text: Certificate of Origin (CO) – shall refer to the document issued by the issuing body of an exporting Party in accordance with Section 5.2;

ai.title: Certificate of Origin (CO)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dokumentong inisyu ng issuing body ng exporting Party ayon sa Sec. 5.2.

paragraphs.text: The AOCG, through the ECD, shall carry out proper examination of all applications for Approved Exporter status under the RCEP Agreement. They shall also have the right to request for additional supporting documentary evidence, as necessary.

paragraphs.text: The AOCG, through the ECD, shall maintain an Approved Exporter database to monitor Philippine Approved Exporters relative to their compliance with domestic laws, rules, and regulations pertinent to exportation and the ROO.

ai.title: Approved Exporter Database
ai.content:

paragraphs.text: The PRU or its equivalent units in all ports shall evaluate the authenticity, accuracy, and validity of the Proof of Origin submitted by importers and grant RCEP preferential tariff rates accordingly.

ai.title: Trabaho ng PRU
ai.content:

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sila ang humaharap sa importer sa port. Titingnan nila kung totoo, tama, at valid ang Proof of Origin bago ibigay ang preferential rate.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tatlong tinitingnan: authenticity, accuracy, validity. Tandaan: PRU = import side.

ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Puwedeng mag-request ang PRU o katumbas na units sa ports ng verification, sa pamamagitan ng ECD, kapag may makatwirang duda sa authenticity o validity ng Proof of Origin, o sa accuracy ng impormasyon tungkol sa origin ng goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi puwedeng basta mag-verify; dapat may 'reasonable doubt'. At hindi direkta ang request: sa ECD ito dumadaan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang detalyadong proseso ay nasa Sec. 6.1. Tandaan ang tatlong grounds: authenticity, validity, at accuracy ng origin information.

paragraphs.text: The PRU or its equivalent units in all ports shall be provided access to the RCEP Approved Exporter database and other RCEP Parties' own secured website to view the registered Approved Exporters of other RCEP Parties.

ai.content:

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dalawang posibleng resulta: qualified (may origin criteria at RCEP Country of Origin) o hindi qualified (may basehan ng disapproval).

paragraphs.text: Should the exporting Party fail to meet the conditions set out in Section 5.7.1 a.i and b, the RCEP Country of Origin is the RCEP Party that contributed the highest value of originating materials used in the production of that good in the exporting Party.

ai.title: COO: Fallback Rule
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag hindi natugunan ng exporting Party ang mga kondisyon sa 5.7.1 (a)(i) at (b), ang RCEP Country of Origin ay ang RCEP Party na nag-ambag ng pinakamataas na halaga ng originating materials na ginamit sa paggawa ng good sa exporting Party.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May 'fallback': kung hindi na-meet ang mga kondisyon, ang RCEP Party na pinakamalaki ang ambag na originating materials ang magiging RCEP Country of Origin.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Pinakamataas na halaga ng originating materials ang basehan, hindi ang pinakamaraming dami.

paragraphs.text: Notwithstanding Sections 5.7.1 and 5.7.2, either the RCEP Party contributing originating materials used in the production of the good with the highest rate of customs duty applied by the RCEP importing Party or the RCEP Party with the highest rate of customs duty applied by the RCEP importing Party will be the RCEP Country of Origin, if requested by the importer for purposes of claiming preferential tariff treatment in the RCEP importing Party. When reflecting this in the Proof of Origin, the name of the RCEP Country of Origin will be followed by " * " if Article 2.6.6(a) of the RCEP Agreement is being used or " ** " if Article 2.6.6(b) of the RCEP Agreement is being used, respectively.

ai.title: COO: Importer's Option (Highest Rate)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kahit anuman ang 5.7.1 at 5.7.2, puwedeng ang RCEP Party na nag-ambag ng originating materials na may pinakamataas na customs duty rate na ina-apply ng importing Party, o ang RCEP Party na may pinakamataas na customs duty rate na ina-apply ng importing Party, ang maging RCEP Country of Origin, kung hihilingin ng importer para sa pag-claim ng preferential tariff treatment. Sa Proof of Origin, susundan ng "*" ang pangalan ng RCEP Country of Origin kung Art. 2.6.6(a) ng RCEP ang ginagamit, o "**" kung Art. 2.6.6(b).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May opsyon ang importer na humiling ng pinakamataas na rate sa halip na ang default. Hindi automatic; kailangang hilingin ng importer.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang marka sa Proof of Origin: "*" para sa Art. 2.6.6(a), "**" para sa Art. 2.6.6(b).

paragraphs.text: Import Procedures in Granting RCEP Preferential Tariff Rates.

ai.content:

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang rate na ilalapat ay galing sa Schedule of Commitments ng Pilipinas sa EO 25.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dalawang basehan: Art. 3.2 ng RCEP (originating) at EO No. 25, s. 2023 (Schedule of Commitments).

paragraphs.text: An original copy of any Proof of Origin must be submitted along with the other pertinent documents before a claim for preferential tariff treatment under the RCEP Agreement can be made.

ai.content:

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi laging papel ang Proof of Origin; may RCEP Parties na puwedeng electronic, depende sa kondisyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Reference: RCEP website (rcepsec.org). I-check ang status ng bawat Party.

paragraphs.text: Verification Procedures for Imported Goods Covered by Proof of Origin.

ai.title: Verification ng Imported Goods: Heading
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Heading ito ng Sec. 6.1, ang verification procedures para sa imported goods na may Proof of Origin.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang import-side verification: kapag may duda ang BOC sa Proof of Origin ng dumating na shipment, dito ang hakbang.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Sakop ng 6.1.1 hanggang 6.1.10. Karamihan ng exam numbers (30, 90, 180, 60 days at 3 years) ay nandito.

paragraphs.text: Pursuant to Article 3.24 (Verification) of the RCEP Agreement, the BOC may request for a verification of the Proof of Origin to the importer, exporter, producer, or issuing body or competent authority of the RCEP exporting Party indicating the reason/s thereof. Verification requests may occur up to three (3) years after the date of importation;

ai.title: Imports: Sino ang Puwedeng I-verify at Hanggang Kailan
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ayon sa Art. 3.24 (Verification) ng RCEP, puwedeng mag-request ang BOC ng verification ng Proof of Origin sa importer, exporter, producer, o issuing body o competent authority ng RCEP exporting Party, kasama ang mga dahilan. Puwedeng mangyari ang verification requests hanggang tatlong taon pagkatapos ng petsa ng importation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lang importer ang puwedeng i-verify; pati exporter, producer, at issuing body. At hindi agad natatapos ang risk: hanggang 3 taon pagkatapos ng importation.

📦 Halimbawa: Isang importer ang nakakuha ng RCEP rate sa shipment ngayong buwan. Hanggang tatlong taon mula sa petsa ng importation, puwede pa ring mag-request ang BOC ng verification ng Proof of Origin nito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Memorize: 3 years mula importation. Dapat may nakasaad na reason ang request.

paragraphs.text: The PRU or its equivalent units in all ports may conduct verification, for the purpose of determining whether a good imported qualifies as an originating good, or determining the authenticity and validity of the Proof of Origin, through a written request or verification visit;

ai.title: Imports: Written Request o Verification Visit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang PRU o katumbas na units sa ports ay puwedeng magsagawa ng verification, para malaman kung qualified bilang originating ang imported good o kung authentic at valid ang Proof of Origin, sa pamamagitan ng written request o verification visit.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dalawang paraan: sulat o pagbisita. Layunin: i-check ang originating status o ang authenticity at validity ng Proof of Origin.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Written request (6.1.3 hanggang 6.1.8) at verification visit (6.1.9, 6.1.10).

paragraphs.text: The written request for verification to the exporter, producer, issuing body or competent authority, shall be accompanied by a copy of the Proof of Origin being verified and shall specify the reason/s for verification such as the authenticity and validity of the Proof of Origin or as to the accuracy of the information regarding the origin of the goods;

ai.title: Imports: Laman ng Written Request
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang written request para sa verification sa exporter, producer, issuing body, o competent authority ay kailangang may kasamang kopya ng Proof of Origin na bini-verify at nakasaad ang mga dahilan, tulad ng authenticity at validity ng Proof of Origin o accuracy ng impormasyon tungkol sa origin.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi puwedeng basta sulat lang. Kailangan ng kopya ng Proof of Origin at malinaw na dahilan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dalawang laman: kopya ng Proof of Origin at reasons.

paragraphs.text: The written request for verification shall be endorsed by the PRU or its equivalent units in all ports through the District Collector of the port concerned and shall be forwarded to the AOCG through the ECD;

ai.title: Imports: Daan ng Request
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang written request para sa verification ay ie-endorse ng PRU o katumbas na units sa ports sa pamamagitan ng District Collector ng port, at ipapasa sa AOCG sa pamamagitan ng ECD.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Daan ng request: PRU → District Collector → AOCG sa pamamagitan ng ECD.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Pansinin ang daan: PRU, District Collector, ECD/AOCG. Hindi direktang sa ibang bansa.

paragraphs.text: The ECD shall send the written request to the importer, exporter, producer or to the issuing body or competent authority of the RCEP exporting Party. The importer, exporter, producer or the issuing body or competent authority of the RCEP exporting Party shall be given between thirty (30) days and ninety (90) days from the date of receipt of the written request to provide additional information relative to the written request made by the BOC;

ai.title: Imports: Reply Period (30 hanggang 90 Days)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ipapadala ng ECD ang written request sa importer, exporter, producer, o sa issuing body o competent authority ng RCEP exporting Party. Bibigyan sila ng 30 hanggang 90 araw mula sa pagtanggap ng request para magbigay ng karagdagang impormasyon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang ECD ang nagpapadala. Ang sasagot ay may 30 hanggang 90 araw para magbigay ng dagdag na impormasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Memorize: 30 hanggang 90 days mula sa pagtanggap ng written request.

paragraphs.text: Upon receipt of the verification reply, the PRU or its equivalent units in all ports shall make a decision within ninety (90) and one hundred eighty (180) days from the date of its receipt of the information necessary to make the determination whether or not the goods imported qualify as originating goods or on the authenticity or validity of the Proof of Origin;

ai.title: Imports: Decision Period (90 hanggang 180 Days)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagkatanggap ng verification reply, ang PRU o katumbas na units sa ports ay magdedesisyon sa loob ng 90 hanggang 180 araw mula sa pagtanggap ng impormasyong kailangan, kung qualified ba bilang originating ang imported goods o kung authentic at valid ang Proof of Origin.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May window ang PRU para magdesisyon: 90 hanggang 180 araw mula nang matanggap ang kinakailangang impormasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Memorize: 90 hanggang 180 days. Huwag ihalo sa 30 hanggang 90 days ng reply period.

paragraphs.text: If the goods have yet to be released, the Proof of Origin that is subject to verification shall have a guarantee in the form of manager's check equivalent to the difference of the duties and taxes based on the applicable Most-Favoured Nation (MFN) and RCEP rates before the release of goods. In cases where the verification check is limited only to certain goods, the guarantee shall only cover these goods. The Cash Division of the port concerned shall hold in abeyance the manager's check until ECD orders its deposit or return;

ai.title: Imports: Guarantee Bago ang Release
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung hindi pa nare-release ang goods, ang Proof of Origin na bini-verify ay may guarantee na manager's check na katumbas ng diperensya ng duties at taxes sa pagitan ng applicable MFN at RCEP rates bago i-release ang goods. Kung limitado lang sa ilang goods ang verification, ang guarantee ay sa mga goods lang na iyon. Ang Cash Division ng port ang hahawak ng manager's check hanggang utusan ng ECD na i-deposit o ibalik.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Habang may verification, puwedeng ma-release ang goods kung may guarantee. Ang halaga ng guarantee ay ang diperensya ng MFN at RCEP duties at taxes.

📦 Halimbawa: May shipment na under verification pero hindi pa nare-release. Para ma-release, magbibigay ang importer ng manager's check na katumbas ng pagkakaiba ng MFN at RCEP duties at taxes. Hahawakan ito ng Cash Division hanggang may utos ang ECD.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Manager's check ang anyo. Cash Division ng port ang hahawak. ECD ang mag-uutos kung ide-deposit o ibabalik.

paragraphs.text: The PRU or its equivalent units in all ports may suspend the granting of preferential tariff treatment for the same goods from the succeeding shipments of the same exporter or producer while waiting for the result of verification. However, the goods may be released provided that the subject shipment shall have a guarantee in the form of manager's check equivalent to the difference of the duties and taxes based on the applicable MFN and RCEP rates before the release of goods;

ai.title: Imports: Suspension sa Susunod na Shipments
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Puwedeng suspindihin ng PRU o katumbas na units sa ports ang pagbibigay ng preferential tariff treatment sa parehong goods mula sa susunod na shipments ng parehong exporter o producer habang hinihintay ang resulta ng verification. title: Procedures on the Processing of Claims for Duty Drawback Pursuant to Customs Administrative Order (CAO) No. 4-2019
subject: Processing of Duty Drawback claims at the Bureau of Customs, including claims transferred from the DOF 'CENTER'

ai.title: CMO 16-2023: Pagproseso ng Duty Drawback Claims
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CMO 16-2023 ang patakaran ng Bureau of Customs sa pagproseso ng mga claim para sa Duty Drawback ayon sa CAO No. 04-2019. Ang Duty Drawback ay ang pagbabalik (karaniwan sa anyo ng Tax Credit Certificate o TCC) ng customs duties na nabayaran sa imported materials o fuel na ginamit o na-export, sa ilalim ng Sec. 900 ng CMTA.

🔍 Breakdown: Sec. 1 Scope. Sec. 2 Objectives (guidelines, walang double claim, claims mula sa CENTER). Sec. 3 General Provisions: 3.1 kailan puwedeng mag-claim (3.1.1 fuel, 3.1.2 petroleum, 3.1.3 imported materials), 3.2 double claim, 3.3 walang VAT o excise, 3.4 processing fee, 3.5 prescriptive period, 3.6 processing period, 3.7 form of payment (TCC), 3.8 utilization, 3.9 notice sa PCAG, 3.10 inspeksyon. Sec. 4 Operational Procedures: 4.1 documentary requirements, 4.2 filing at processing. Sec. 5 Special procedure sa claims galing sa CENTER. Sec. 6 pending claims sa ports. Sec. 7 manpower. Sec. 8 remedies. Sec. 9-10 separability at effectivity. Kasama ang Annex A, Annex B, at Formula of Conversion form.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag nag-import ka ng materials at nagbayad ng duties, tapos ginawa mong produkto at ini-export, hindi dapat ikaw ang magdala ng duties na iyon. Puwede kang mag-claim ng drawback. Dati sa DOF 'CENTER' ito pinoproseso. Ngayon, sa BOC na (sa pamamagitan ng TCC Secretariat) dahil sa AO No. 04, s. 2023.

📦 Halimbawa: Isang manufacturer ang nag-import ng raw materials at nagbayad ng duties, tapos ini-export ang finished goods sa loob ng isang (1) taon. Mag-fa-file siya ng claim sa loob ng anim (6) na buwan mula sa exportation. Gagawa muna siya ng ticket sa CCPS at mag-a-upload ng initial documents, saka magpapasa ng hard copies sa Customer Care Center sa loob ng 24 oras. Susuriin ng TCC Secretariat ang papeles at ang computation gamit ang ITDI Formula of Conversion. Kapag aprubado, TCC ang matatanggap niya.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Ito ang pangunahing batayan ng proseso ng Duty Drawback sa BOC ngayon. Madalas itanong sa exam ang mga percentage cap, deadline, dokumento, at remedyo.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hanggang 99% ng duty para sa fuel (3.1.1). Hanggang 50% para sa petroleum oils na ibinenta sa electric utilities (3.1.2). Hanggang 100% para sa imported materials sa manufacturing (3.1.3). Prescriptive period: 1 year mula importation (3.1.1 at 3.1.2) o 6 months mula exportation (3.1.3), may extension na another 6 months na dapat i-request 30 days bago ang lapse, at hindi lalampas ng 1 year mula exportation (3.5.2). Export sa loob ng 1 year mula importation (3.1.3.d). Processing: 60 days, maximum 120 days (3.6). Processing fee: Php 700 hanggang Php 5,000 (3.4). TCC validity: 5 years, puwedeng i-revalidate ng 5 years, hanggang 10 years lang (3.7). Walang VAT o excise sa claim (3.3). First-time claimants: kailangan ng inspeksyon (3.10). Hard copies sa CCC: 24 hours mula ticket creation (4.2.2). Motion for Reconsideration: 10 days. Appeal sa CTA: 30 days. Effectivity: 01 NOV 2023.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: Memorize ang mga numero (99%, 50%, 100%, 1 year, 6 months, 60/120 days, 5+5 years, 24 hours, 10 days, 30 days) at ang pagkakaiba ng 3.1.1, 3.1.2, at 3.1.3. Alamin din kung sino ang nagpoproseso (TCC Secretariat), saan nagfa-file (CCPS), at saan ang hard copies (CCC). Tandaan na customs duties lang ang sakop, hindi VAT o excise.

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Tanong: Cash ba ang refund ng Duty Drawback?
Sagot: Hindi. Ayon sa 3.7, TCC ang bayad maliban kung may special provision ang General Appropriations Act (GAA).

🔗 Related Topics: CMTA Sec. 900, 901, at 913. CAO 04-2019. CAO 14-72 as amended by CAO 31-76. AO No. 04, s. 2023. Rules sa utilization ng TCC.

paragraphs.text: Prohibition against Double Claim. A registered enterprise under Republic Act No. 5186, otherwise known as the "Investment Incentives Act", or Republic Act No. 6135, otherwise known as the "Export Incentives Act of 1970", which has previously applied for tax credits with the Board of Investments (BOI) based on customs duties paid on imported raw materials and supplies, shall not be entitled to Duty Drawback under this section with respect to the same importation subsequently processed and re-exported.⁴

ai.title: 3.2: Prohibition against Double Claim
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang registered enterprise sa ilalim ng RA No. 5186 (Investment Incentives Act) o RA No. 6135 (Export Incentives Act of 1970) na dati nang nag-apply ng tax credits sa Board of Investments (BOI) batay sa customs duties na nabayaran sa imported raw materials at supplies ay hindi entitled sa Duty Drawback sa ilalim ng section na ito para sa parehong importation na pinroseso at ni-re-export.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag nakakuha ka na ng tax credit sa BOI para sa parehong imported materials, hindi ka na puwedeng mag-claim ng Duty Drawback dito. Isa lang ang puwede.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Footnote 4 = CMTA Sec. 901. Kaya may requirement na Certificate of Non-Availment of Incentives mula sa BOI (4.1.2 at 4.2.1.e) at may verification sa 4.2.4.b.

paragraphs.text: The processing of application is limited to Duty Drawback only. If internal revenue taxes like Value-Added Tax or Excise Tax are included in the filed claim for Duty Drawback in the Bureau, the same should be disallowed and the Bureau must process only the portion of customs duties paid to avoid any duplication of claim for internal revenue taxes. Claims for refund of internal revenue taxes shall be subject to the rules and regulations issued by the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR).

ai.title: 3.3: Customs Duties Lang, Walang VAT o Excise
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Duty Drawback lang ang pinoproseso ng BOC. Kung may internal revenue taxes tulad ng VAT o Excise Tax sa claim na na-file sa BOC, dapat itong i-disallow at ang bahagi lang ng customs duties na nabayaran ang ipoproseso. Ang claims para sa internal revenue taxes ay susunod sa rules ng BIR.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi puwedeng isama ang VAT o excise tax sa Duty Drawback claim. BOC = customs duties lang. BIR = internal revenue taxes.

📦 Halimbawa: May claim na kasama ang VAT sa import entry. Idi-disallow ng BOC ang VAT portion at customs duties lang ang ipoproseso.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Layunin: iwas duplication ng claim sa internal revenue taxes. Ang VAT at Excise Tax claims ay sa BIR rules.

Payment of Processing Fee. Claims for Duty Drawback shall be processed only after payment of the required processing fee and the submission of complete documents to the Bureau. Pursuant to CAO No. 04-2019, the processing fees shall be based on the following schedule:
Amount of Claim (Php) | Processing Fees (Php)
Up to 50,000.00 | 700.00
Over 50,000.00 to 100,000.00 | 900.00
Over 100,000.00 to 200,000.00 | 1,100.00
Over 200,000.00 to 300,000.00 | 1,300.00
Over 300,000.00 to 400,000.00 | 1,500.00
Over 400,000.00 to 500,000.00 | 1,700.00
Over 500,000.00 to 750,000.00 | 2,300.00
Over 750,000.00 to 1,000,000.00 | 3,000.00
Over 1,000,000.00 to 5,000,000.00 | 4,000.00
Over 5,000,000.00 | 5,000.00

ai.title: 3.4: Processing Fee
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ipoproseso lang ang claims para sa Duty Drawback pagkatapos mabayaran ang required processing fee at maisumite ang kumpletong dokumento sa Bureau. Ayon sa CAO No. 04-2019, ang processing fee ay base sa schedule na nakalista: mula Php 700 (hanggang Php 50,000 na claim) hanggang Php 5,000 (over Php 5,000,000 na claim).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bayad muna at kumpleto muna ang papeles bago magsimula ang processing. Mas malaki ang claim, mas mataas ang fee, hanggang Php 5,000 maximum.

📦 Halimbawa: Para sa claim na Php 600,000, nasa bracket ito ng over Php 500,000 hanggang Php 750,000, kaya Php 2,300 ang fee.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Sampung tiers ang schedule. Pinakamababa: Php 700 para sa claim na up to Php 50,000. Pinakamataas: Php 5,000 para sa claim na over Php 5,000,000. Proof of payment ng processing fee ay kasama sa requirements (4.1.2, 4.2.1.f).

ai.title: Computation Step 2: Quantity ng Raw Materials
ai.content:

paragraphs.label: iii.
paragraphs.text: Computation for the amount of refund. The amount of Duty Drawback shall be determined by first computing the duty paid for every raw material unit and multiplying this factor with the total quantity of the raw material used for the export quantity, as determined above.

ai.title: Computation Step 3: Amount ng Refund
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagkuwenta sa amount ng refund. Ang Duty Drawback ay ide-determine sa pamamagitan ng unang pag-compute ng duty na nabayaran kada raw material unit, at pagpaparami ng factor na ito sa kabuuang quantity ng raw material na ginamit para sa export quantity na natukoy sa naunang hakbang.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ikatlo: duty per raw material unit × quantity ng raw material na nagamit sa na-export.

📦 Halimbawa: Kung Php 10 ang duty per unit ng raw material at 1,000 units ang nagamit para sa na-export na produkto, Php 10,000 ang Duty Drawback (halimbawa lang).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Formula: duty paid per unit ng raw material × total quantity ng raw material na ginamit para sa export quantity.

title: INTEGRATION OF THE ELECTRONIC CUSTOMS BAGGAGE DECLARATION AND CURRENCIES DECLARATION IN THE ETRAVEL SYSTEM
subject: Integration ng e-CBDF at e-CDF sa eTravel System (eTravel Customs System)
effectivity: This Order shall take effect immediately.
related: BSP Circular No. 1146, series of 2022 (Sections 4.1, 4.2, Annex K)
RA 10863 (CMTA), Title VIII, Chapter 1, Sec. 800 (g); Sec. 1431; Sec. 1505

ai.title: CMO 17-2023 Overview
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CMO 17-2023 ang nagsasama ng Electronic Customs Baggage Declaration Form (e-CBDF) at Electronic Currencies Declaration Form (e-CDF) sa eTravel System, para digital na ang customs declaration ng arriving at departing na Travelers at Crew Members.

🔍 Breakdown: Sec. 1-3 scope, objectives, definitions. Sec. 4-5 general at administrative provisions (users at access levels). Sec. 6 procedure para sa arriving (lanes, assessment, currency, restricted goods, HBR). Sec. 7 para sa departing. Sec. 8-11 process flow, kiosk, paper form, help desk. Sec. 12-16 confidentiality, review, repeal, separability, effectivity. Annex A ang process flow chart.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dati papel ang declaration; ngayon online na. Fill-out sa eTravel within 72 hours bago dumating o umalis, tapos QR Code ang ipapakita mo sa Customs.

📦 Halimbawa: Si Ana, OFW, dumating na may 2 balikbayan box at USD12,000 cash. Nag-fill out siya ng e-CBDF at e-CDF sa eTravel, ipinakita ang QR Code, at dahil may currency declaration, dumaan siya sa examination at counting sa secondary room.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Ito ang pangunahing guide sa daily operations ng customs sa airports at seaports pagdating sa baggage at currency declaration, kaya madalas itong lumalabas sa board exam.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 72 hours ang window; threshold ay USD10,000 (foreign) at Php50,000 (Philippine currency); ang lampas Php50,000 ay nangangailangan ng prior authorization ng BSP.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: Memorize ang thresholds, ang 72-hour rule, ang pagkakaiba ng Green Lane at Red Lane, at ang mga dahilan ng pag-issue ng HBR.

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Kailangan bang mag-declare sa e-CDF kapag eksaktong USD10,000? Hindi. 'USD10,000 and below' ay hindi kailangang i-declare; ang 'in excess' lang ang kailangan.

🔗 Related Topics: CAO 1-2017, CAO 2-2014, BSP Circular No. 1146 (s. 2022), CMTA (RA 10863), Data Privacy Act (RA 10173).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang buong CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa integration ng e-CBDF at e-CDF sa eTravel System. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: This Order shall cover the operational procedure for the use of the eTravel Customs System for all Travelers and Crew Members arriving at or departing from all airports and seaports of entry and exit.

ai.title: Saklaw ng Order
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sinasabi ng Scope kung kanino at saan nag-a-apply ang CMO: sa operational procedure ng eTravel Customs System.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Lahat ng Travelers at Crew Members na dumarating o umaalis, sa lahat ng airports at seaports, ay sakop.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Sakop ang arrival AT departure, at parehong Travelers at Crew Members.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 1 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa scope ng eTravel Customs System. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To provide the guidelines on the customs clearance process for all Travelers and Crew Members arriving and departing using Electronic Customs Baggage Declaration Form (e-CBDF) and Electronic Currencies Declaration Form (eCDF) in the eTravel System in relation to Customs Administrative Order (CAO) No. 1-2017.

ai.title: Layunin ng Order
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Layunin ng CMO na magbigay ng guidelines sa customs clearance gamit ang e-CBDF at e-CDF sa eTravel System.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'rulebook' kung paano malilinis ng Customs ang mga pasahero gamit ang digital forms.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Naka-link ito sa CAO No. 1-2017, kaya basahin silang magkasama.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa objectives ng e-CBDF at e-CDF. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: For purposes of this Order, the following terms are defined accordingly:

ai.title: Intro ng Definitions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Panimulang linya ng Section 3 na nagsasabing ang mga terms sa ibaba ay para lang sa Order na ito.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag may term na nakasulat dito, ito ang gagamiting meaning sa buong CMO, kahit iba ang gamit sa ibang batas.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'For purposes of this Order' ang susi; limitado ang saklaw ng definitions.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa definition of terms. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Crew Member – shall refer to person/s assigned by an Air or Vessel Operator to render duty during a flight or voyage duty period;

ai.title: Crew Member
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Crew Member ay taong itinalaga ng Air o Vessel Operator na magtrabaho sa flight o voyage duty period.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Piloto, flight attendant, o seafarer na naka-duty; hindi sila ordinaryong pasahero.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: May special lane at mandatory physical examination ang Crew Members (Sec. 4.5 at 6.2.4).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.1 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa definition ng Crew Member. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Commercial Quantity – shall refer to the quantity for a given kind or class of articles which are in excess of what is compatible with and commensurate to the person’s normal requirements for personal use;

ai.title: Commercial Quantity
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ito ang dami ng isang uri ng gamit na lampas sa normal na kailangan ng tao para sa personal use.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kung mukhang pang-negosyo na ang dami, hindi na ito 'personal use'. Halimbawa, 20 pare-parehong cellphone.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang commercial quantity ay may sariling lane (Sec. 4.5.4) at departure procedure (Sec. 7.10).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.2 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa Commercial Quantity. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Electronic Customs Baggage Declaration Form (e-CBDF) – shall refer to the electronic form of the Customs Baggage Declaration Form in the eTravel System prescribed by the Bureau of Customs and to be accomplished by all arriving Travelers and Crew Members;

ai.title: e-CBDF
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang e-CBDF ay electronic na Customs Baggage Declaration Form sa eTravel System na inireseta ng BOC.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang digital baggage declaration; lahat ng arriving Travelers at Crew Members ay kailangang mag-fill out.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: BOC ang nagre-prescribe ng e-CBDF; BSP naman ang sa e-CDF.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.3 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa e-CBDF. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Electronic Currencies Declaration Form (e-CDF) – shall refer to the electronic form of the Currencies Declaration Form in the eTravel System prescribed by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and required to be filled-out by Travelers and Crew Members bringing in or taking out foreign currency in excess of US$10,000 or its equivalent in other foreign currency and bearer monetary instruments, or bringing in or taking out legal tender Philippine notes and coins, checks, money order and other bills of exchange drawn in peso against banks operating in the Philippines in an amount exceeding Php50,000;

ai.title: e-CDF
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang e-CDF ay electronic na Currencies Declaration Form sa eTravel System na inireseta ng BSP.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kailangan ito kapag may dala o dadalhin palabas na foreign currency na lampas US$10,000, o Philippine currency na lampas Php50,000.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dalawang threshold: US$10,000 para sa foreign currency at bearer instruments, Php50,000 para sa peso notes, coins, checks, money orders at bills of exchange. Ang 'in excess' o 'exceeding' ang trigger.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.4 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa e-CDF. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: eTravel System – shall refer to a digital single data collection platform for passengers arriving in and departing from the Philippines, which shall be utilized for border control, health surveillance, and economic data analysis;

ai.title: eTravel System
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang eTravel System ay iisang digital platform sa pagkolekta ng data ng mga pasaherong dumarating at umaalis ng Pilipinas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Isang system para sa border control, health surveillance, at economic data analysis.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Mas malawak ang eTravel System kaysa sa eTravel Customs System.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.5 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa eTravel System. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: eTravel Customs System – shall refer to the integration of the e-CBDF and e-CDF in the eTravel System;

ai.title: eTravel Customs System
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang eTravel Customs System ay ang integration ng e-CBDF at e-CDF sa loob ng eTravel System.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'customs portion' ng eTravel, kung saan ginagawa ang baggage at currency declaration.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ito ang system na tinutukoy sa halos lahat ng probisyon ng Order.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.6 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa eTravel Customs System. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Fraud – shall refer to acts knowingly, voluntarily, and intentionally committed or omitted which prejudice the interest of the government, e.g., submitting fake or spurious document, making material untruthful statement(s) or committing any other analogous act(s) or omission(s);

ai.title: Fraud
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Fraud ay sinasadyang gawa o pagkukulang na nakakasama sa interes ng gobyerno, gaya ng pekeng dokumento o maling pahayag.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi ito basta pagkakamali; kailangang 'knowingly, voluntarily, and intentionally'.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kapag may fraud sa currency declaration, ipinapasa ang Traveler sa ESS para sa investigation (Sec. 6.7.15).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.7 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa definition ng Fraud. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Non-Resident Filipinos – refer to Filipinos those who have established permanent residency abroad but have retained Filipino citizenship, whether or not they have availed of the benefits under Republic Act No. 9225 or the Citizenship Retention and Re-acquisition Act of 2003;

ai.title: Non-Resident Filipinos
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Mga Pilipinong permanent resident na sa ibang bansa pero Filipino citizen pa rin.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kahit hindi sila nag-avail ng benefits ng RA 9225, kasama pa rin sila sa kahulugan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kasama sila sa lane para sa OFWs at Returning Residents (Sec. 4.5.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.8 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa Non-Resident Filipinos. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Owner’s Pre-Departure Declaration Form (OPDD) – shall refer to a document secured upon departure and issued by the District Collector or any authorized Customs Officer identifying goods to be exported and subsequently brought back by Travelers;

ai.title: OPDD
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang OPDD ay dokumentong kinukuha pag-alis, inilalabas ng District Collector o authorized Customs Officer, na naglilista ng goods na ie-export at ibabalik ng Traveler.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Parang tala na ito ang gamit na dinala mo palabas at ibinabalik mo lang pag-uwi.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Pre-departure ito at hinihingi sa Sec. 6.1.2(d) at Sec. 7.10.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.9 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa Owner's Pre-Departure Declaration Form (OPDD). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) – refers to a holder of a valid passport issued by the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) and certified by Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) or the Philippine Overseas Employment Administration (POEA) for overseas employment purposes. This covers all Filipinos working in a foreign country under employment contracts, regardless of their professions, skills or employment status in a foreign country. For purposes of this CAO, the term OFW includes Filipinos working abroad under job contracts who do not require a certification from the DOLE or POEA; and

ai.title: Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang OFW ay may valid DFA passport na certified ng DOLE o POEA para sa overseas employment, at sakop ang lahat ng Pilipinong may employment contract abroad.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi mahalaga ang propesyon o skills mo. Kasama rin ang mga hindi na nangangailangan ng DOLE o POEA certification.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang OFW ay may sariling lane sa Sec. 4.5.1, kasama ng Returning Residents at Non-Resident Filipinos.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.10 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa definition ng Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Traveler – shall refer to any person who temporarily enters the territory of a country in which he or she does not normally reside (“non-resident”) or who leaves that territory; or any person who leaves the territory of a country in which he or she normally resides (“departing resident”) or who returns to that territory (“Returning Resident”).

ai.title: Traveler
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Traveler ay sinumang pansamantalang pumapasok sa bansang hindi siya karaniwang naninirahan, o umaalis dito; o sinumang umaalis o bumabalik sa bansang tinitirhan niya.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Tatlong uri: non-resident, departing resident, at Returning Resident.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang Traveler ay iba sa Crew Member; magkaiba ang treatment nila sa lanes.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.11 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa definition ng Traveler. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Bureau shall adopt and utilize the eTravel System to automate the documentation process for all arriving or departing Travelers and Crew Members, thereby facilitating their ingress or egress from immigration and customs in all international airports and seaports of entry or exit.

ai.title: Adoption ng eTravel System
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Obligasyon ng Bureau na gamitin ang eTravel System para i-automate ang documentation ng lahat ng arriving at departing Travelers at Crew Members.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Layunin nitong pabilisin ang pagdaan sa immigration at customs sa lahat ng international airports at seaports.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Automation ang pangunahing layunin; 'shall adopt and utilize' ay mandatory.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.1 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa adoption ng eTravel System. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The eTravel System is an online platform for Travelers or Crew Members to register passenger information for Bureau of Immigration purposes, including health declaration for the Bureau of Quarantine, for arriving passengers.

ai.title: Layunin ng eTravel System
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Online platform ang eTravel System para magparehistro ng passenger information para sa Bureau of Immigration, kasama ang health declaration para sa Bureau of Quarantine ng mga arriving passengers.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lang customs ang laman ng eTravel; may immigration at health parts din.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang customs portion ay naka-integrate lang dito (Sec. 4.3).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.2 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa eTravel System bilang online platform. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The eTravel Customs System is also integrated in the eTravel System whereby the arriving or departing Travelers or Crew Members will be required to accomplish the e-CBDF, and/or the e-CDF, if applicable, for customs purposes.

ai.title: Integration ng Customs System
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Naka-integrate ang eTravel Customs System sa eTravel System, kaya kailangang mag-fill out ng e-CBDF at/o e-CDF, kung applicable, para sa customs purposes.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Isang online na proseso na; sa parehong portal mo gagawin ang customs declaration.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'If applicable' ang e-CDF; hindi lahat ay kailangang mag-fill out nito.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.3 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa integration ng eTravel Customs System. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Travelers and Crew Members can access the eTravel Customs system by logging in at https://etravel.gov.ph/ within seventy-two (72) hours before arrival or departure.

ai.title: 72-Hour Access

paragraphs.text:
Declaration | Requirement
1 | Philippine Currency and/or any Philippine Monetary Instrument in excess of Php50,000.00 | Accomplish the Electronic Currencies Declaration Form (e-CDF) in the eTravel Customs System; and Prior Authorization from the BSP
2 | Foreign Currency and/or Foreign Monetary Instrument in excess of USD 10,000.00 or its equivalent | Accomplish the Electronic Currencies Declaration Form (e-CDF) in the eTravel Customs System
3 | Gambling Paraphernalia | Prior import permit/clearance/license from the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation
4 | Cosmetics, skin care products, food supplements and medicines in excess of quantities for personal use; | Prior import permit/clearance/license from the Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
5 | Dangerous drugs such as marijuana, morphine, opium, poppies or synthetic drugs | Prior import permit/clearance/license from the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency
6 | Firearms, ammunitions and explosives | Prior import permit/clearance/license from the Firearms and Explosives Office, Philippine National Police
7 | Alcohol and/or tobacco products in commercial quantities | Prior import permit/clearance/license from the FDA or National Tobacco Administration for tobacco products
8 | Foodstuffs in commercial quantity | Prior import permit/clearance/license from the FDA
9 | Fruit(s), vegetables | Prior import permit/clearance/license from the Bureau of Plant Industry
10 | Live animal(s), meat, eggs, etc. | Prior import permit/clearance/license from the Bureau of Animal Industry
11 | Marine and aquatic product(s), and/or the product(s) and their by-product(s) | Prior import permit/clearance/license from the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources
12 | Mobile phones in excess if quantities for personal use, and radio communication equipment | Prior import permit/clearance/license from the National Telecommunications Commission
13 | Remains (human ashes), human organs or tissues | Prior import permit/clearance/license from the Bureau of Quarantine
14 | Jewelry, gold, precious metals or gems | NA
15 | Other goods, not mentioned above | Other goods which require prior import permit/clearance/license from the concerned regulatory agency

ai.title: Table ng Declarations at Requirements
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Table ito ng 15 uri ng dala at ng required na form, permit o clearance, kasama ang agency na nag-iisyu.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pera: e-CDF (at BSP authorization para sa peso). Gambling items: PAGCOR. Gamot at cosmetics: FDA. Droga: PDEA. Baril: PNP FEO. Alak o tobacco: FDA o NTA. Prutas at gulay: BPI. Hayop at karne: BAI. Seafood: BFAR. Cellphone at radio: NTC. Human remains: Bureau of Quarantine. Alahas: NA.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Item 14 (jewelry, gold, precious metals o gems) ay 'NA', walang permit na nakalista. Ang item 15 ay catch-all para sa ibang goods.

paragraphs.text: Clearance Channels. According to his/her declaration, the Traveler or Crew Member shall proceed to the following channels, as applicable:

paragraphs.text: Pursuant to the risk management selection process such as random and/or reasoned selection or on account of intelligence information, a Customs Officer may direct any Traveler or Crew Member arriving in all ports of entry to the RED LANE regardless of his/her declaration in the e-CBDF or e-CDF; and

paragraphs.text: Clearance without Payment. Baggage not containing any dutiable or taxable goods shall be cleared immediately by the Examiner by attaching his/her electronic signature to the e-CBDF.

paragraphs.text: Clearance with Payment. Baggage found to contain dutiable or taxable goods shall be assessed with duties, taxes, and other charges and shall be processed in the eTravel Customs System as follows:
