ai.title: Review ng Supervisor
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ire-review ng Supervisor o equivalent officer ang assessment at findings ng Examiner. Kapag sang-ayon siya, pipirmahan niya ang e-CBDF.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang pirma ng Supervisor ang approval ng assessment.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'Conforms' ang susi; kung hindi, tingnan ang 6.6.4.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.6.3 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa review ng Supervisor sa assessment. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the Supervisor or equivalent Customs officer does not conform with the assessment, he or she shall indicate her remarks in the e-CBDF and return the same to the Customs Examiner for re-assessment.

ai.title: Hindi Sang-ayon ang Supervisor
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung hindi sang-ayon ang Supervisor, maglalagay siya ng remarks sa e-CBDF at ibabalik sa Examiner para sa re-assessment.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May feedback loop: ibabalik para itama.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Remarks ang batayan ng re-assessment.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.6.4 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pagbabalik ng e-CBDF para sa re-assessment. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Customs Examiner shall check the returned e-CBDF and start re-assessment and indicate remarks, accordingly. After re-assessment, the Customs Examiner shall then affix his or her signature in the e-CBDF and tag the same for approval of the Supervisor or equivalent Customs officer.

ai.title: Re-Assessment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Titingnan ng Examiner ang ibinalik na e-CBDF, magre-re-assess, maglalagay ng remarks, pipirma, at ita-tag ulit para sa approval ng Supervisor.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Uulit ang cycle hanggang aprubahan ng Supervisor.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kailangan pa ring ma-approve ulit ng Supervisor.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.6.5 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa re-assessment ng Customs Examiner. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Once the assessment is approved by the Supervisor or equivalent Customs officer, the Customs Examiner shall inform the Travelers or Crew Members of the total amount of the assessed duties, taxes, and other charges. If the Traveler or Crew Member agrees to pay the total amount of duties, taxes, and other charges, the Customs Appraiser or equivalent officer shall tag the e-CBDF for payment.

ai.title: Pagsabi ng Halaga at Tag for Payment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag naaprubahan na ang assessment, sasabihin ng Examiner ang kabuuang duties, taxes at charges. Kung pumayag magbayad ang Traveler, ita-tag ng Customs Appraiser o equivalent officer ang e-CBDF for payment.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Malalaman mo muna ang halaga, at kapag pumayag ka, saka ka makakapunta sa Cashier.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang Customs Appraiser o equivalent officer ang nagta-tag for payment.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.6.6 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pagsabi ng assessed amount at pag-tag for payment. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Traveler or Crew Member shall proceed to the Cashier or Collecting Officer for payment.

ai.title: Pagbabayad sa Cashier
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pupunta ang Traveler o Crew Member sa Cashier o Collecting Officer para magbayad.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa Cashier ang bayad, hindi sa Examiner.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.6.7 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pagbabayad sa Cashier o Collecting Officer. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Cashier or Collecting Officer shall view the e-CBDF and collect payment of the taxes due in the findings. Once paid, he/she shall give the original copy of the Bureau of Customs Official Receipt (BCOR) to the Traveler or Crew Member and tag the e-CBDF as “Paid”.

ai.title: Koleksyon at BCOR
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Titingnan ng Cashier ang e-CBDF, kokolektahin ang taxes na nasa findings, ibibigay ang original BCOR, at ita-tag ang e-CBDF bilang 'Paid'.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Resibo mo ang BCOR, at 'Paid' ang tag sa system.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Original copy ng BCOR ang ibinibigay sa Traveler.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.6.8 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa koleksyon ng bayad at pag-issue ng BCOR. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Traveler or Crew Member shall then return to the Customs lane and present the BCOR to Customs Examiner who shall verify the correctness of the amount paid and shall tag the e-CBDF as “Cleared”.

ai.title: Final Clearance
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Babalik ang Traveler sa Customs lane at ipapakita ang BCOR. Ve-verify ng Examiner ang tamang halaga at ita-tag ang e-CBDF bilang 'Cleared'.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi ka pa clear pagkabayad; kailangan pa ring i-verify ng Examiner ang resibo.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'Paid' ang tag ng Cashier, 'Cleared' ang tag ng Examiner.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.6.9 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa final clearance gamit ang BCOR. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: In case the Traveler or Crew Member refuses to pay duties, taxes and other charges or does not have sufficient funds, the baggage and the goods shall be held in the In-Bond Room of the Baggage Assistance Division and a Held Baggage Receipt (HBR) shall be issued to the Traveler or Crew Member as provided under Section 6.9.1 (a) of this Order.

ai.title: Refusal o Kulang na Pondo
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung tumanggi magbayad o kulang ang pondo, ilalagay ang baggage at goods sa In-Bond Room ng Baggage Assistance Division at bibigyan ng HBR ang Traveler.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi mo makukuha ang gamit hangga't hindi nababayaran, pero may resibo kang HBR.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Naka-refer ito sa Sec. 6.9.1(a).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.6.10 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pagtanggi magbayad o kulang na pondo at pag-issue ng HBR. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Clearance with Currency Declaration.

ai.title: Clearance with Currency Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Heading ng procedure sa pag-clear kapag may currency declaration.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Nasa 6.7.1 hanggang 6.7.19 ang thresholds, e-CDF, counting, HBR at fraud.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa clearance with currency declaration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Travelers and Crew Members need not declare in the e-CDF if they are bringing into or taking out of the Philippines:

ai.title: Walang Kailangang I-declare
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Hindi kailangang mag-declare sa e-CDF ang bumibitbit papasok o palabas ng Pilipinas ng halagang hindi lampas sa thresholds sa ibaba.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May 'safe amount' na hindi na kailangang i-declare.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Sakop ang papasok AT palabas.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.1 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa halagang hindi kailangang i-declare sa e-CDF. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: Foreign currency, as well as other foreign currency-denominated bearer money instruments, in an amount of USD10,000 and below or its equivalent; and/or

ai.title: USD10,000 and Below
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Foreign currency at bearer instruments na USD10,000 pababa o katumbas nito ay hindi kailangang i-declare.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kasama ang eksaktong USD10,000 sa hindi kailangang mag-declare.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.1(a) ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa USD10,000 and below. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: Legal tender Philippine notes and coins, checks, money order and other bills of exchange drawn in pesos against banks operating in the Philippines in an amount not exceeding Php50,000.00.

ai.title: Php50,000 Pababa
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Philippine notes, coins, checks, money orders at bills of exchange na hindi lalampas ng Php50,000.00 ay hindi kailangang i-declare.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kasama ang eksaktong Php50,000.00 sa exempt.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.1(b) ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa Php50,000 pababa. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: For Travelers and Crew Members bringing into or taking out foreign or local currency exceeding the threshold provided in Section 6.7.1, the whole amount of local or foreign currency, as well as other currency-denominated bearer money instrument brought into or taken out of the Philippines should be declared using the e-CDF or the physical copy of the Currencies Declaration Form (Annex K of BSP Circular No. 1146, series of 2022).

ai.title: Buong Halaga ang I-declare
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag lampas sa threshold, ang BUONG halaga ng local o foreign currency at bearer instruments ang dapat i-declare gamit ang e-CDF o physical CDF.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lang ang sobra ang idedeklara; lahat ng dala.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kapag USD12,000 ang dala, USD12,000 ang idedeklara, hindi USD2,000 lang.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.2 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pag-declare ng buong halaga ng currency. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Upon the Traveler or Crew Member’s presentation of the duly accomplished e-CDF or CDF, as applicable, the Customs Officer who has jurisdiction to administer oath pursuant to Section 1505 of Republic Act No. 10863 (Customs Modernization Tariff Act) shall receive and administer the oath.

ai.title: Oath sa Currency Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag ipinakita ang accomplished e-CDF o CDF, tatanggapin ito ng Customs Officer na may jurisdiction mag-administer ng oath ayon sa Sec. 1505 ng CMTA, at siya ang magpapa-oath.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sinumpaang declaration ang currency declaration.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hindi lahat ng officer; yung may authority lang mag-administer ng oath.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.3 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pag-administer ng oath sa currency declaration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the Traveler or Crew Member declares in the e-CBDF or verbally declares that he is carrying foreign currency or monetary instruments in excess of USD10,000 or its equivalent, the Examiner shall verify whether the Traveler or Crew Member filled out the e-CDF. If the Traveler or Crew Member filled out the e-CDF, the Examiner shall verify the information provided by the Traveler or Crew Member in the e-CDF with the information in the passport.

ai.title: Pag-verify ng e-CDF
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag idineklara sa e-CBDF o pasalita na may foreign currency na lampas USD10,000, titingnan ng Examiner kung nag-fill out ng e-CDF, at ikukumpara ang laman nito sa passport.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Magkakatugma dapat ang e-CBDF, e-CDF at passport.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Puwedeng pasalita ang pagdeklara, pero e-CDF pa rin ang hinahanap.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.4 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pag-verify ng e-CDF laban sa passport. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Examiner shall print a copy of the e-CDF in three (3) sets.

ai.title: Tatlong Set ng e-CDF
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ipi-print ng Examiner ang e-CDF sa tatlong set.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Tatlong kopya para sa tatlong tatanggap (tingnan ang 6.7.11).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tatlong (3) sets ang bilang.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.5 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pag-print ng e-CDF sa tatlong set. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: In case the Traveler or Crew Member failed to fill out the e-CDF, the Examiner shall provide a hardcopy of the CDF and ask the Traveler or Crew Member to completely accomplish all the boxes in the form. The Examiner shall assist the Traveler or Crew Member in filling out of all the boxes in the CDF.

ai.title: Hardcopy ng CDF
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung hindi nakapag-fill out ng e-CDF, bibigyan ng Examiner ng hardcopy ng CDF at tutulungan ang Traveler na kumpletuhin ang lahat ng boxes.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May fallback na papel kung hindi ka nakagawa ng e-CDF.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Lahat ng boxes ay dapat masagutan.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.6 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa hardcopy ng CDF kung hindi nakapag-fill out ng e-CDF. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Upon submission of the CDF, the Examiner shall check the information in the CDF as filled out by the Traveler or Crew Member as against the information contained in the Traveler or Crew Member’s passport. The Examiner shall ensure that the amount of declared currency shall be written in words and in figures.

ai.title: Pag-check ng CDF
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag na-submit ang CDF, ikukumpara ng Examiner ang laman nito sa passport at titiyaking nakasulat ang halaga sa words at figures.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang halaga ay nakasulat sa salita at numero para iwas dayaan o pagkakamali.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'In words and in figures' ang requirement.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.7 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pag-check ng CDF at halagang nakasulat in words and in figures. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Before counting the currency, the Examiner shall verify with the Traveler or Crew Member whether the amount written in the CDF is the actual amount he/she is bringing in.

ai.title: Kumpirmasyon Bago Magbilang
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Bago magbilang, tatanungin ng Examiner kung ang halagang nakasulat sa CDF ay ang aktwal na dala.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Huling pagkakataon para itama ang declaration bago bilangin ang pera.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ginagawa ito BAGO ang counting.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.8 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pagkumpirma ng halaga bago magbilang ng currency. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The counting of the currency shall be conducted in the secondary examination room in the presence of the Traveler or Crew Member or his/her authorized representative, including the Customs Intelligence & Investigation Services (CIIS) and Enforcement and Security Service (ESS) as witnesses under the supervision of the Flight Supervisor. The X-ray Inspection Project (XIP) Operative shall also act as a witness if the currency was discovered as a result of x-ray scanning. Multi-currency counting machines shall be used, if practicable, in the counting and verification of the currency.

ai.title: Counting ng Currency
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sa secondary examination room ang pagbibilang, kasama ang Traveler o authorized representative, at ang CIIS at ESS bilang witnesses sa ilalim ng Flight Supervisor. Witness din ang XIP Operative kung na-discover sa x-ray. Gagamit ng multi-currency counting machine kung practicable.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi basta-basta bibilangin ang pera; may mga saksi at supervision.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang XIP Operative ay witness lang kung nadiskubre ang pera sa x-ray.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.9 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa counting ng currency at mga witness. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: After the counting of the currency, and the declaration is found to be correct, the Examiner, Flight Supervisor, ESS Witness, and CIIS Witness shall affix their signatures in the CDF. The Traveler or Crew Member shall be cleared and the currencies shall be released.

ai.title: Clearance Kapag Tama
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag tama ang declaration pagkatapos magbilang, pipirmahan ng Examiner, Flight Supervisor, ESS Witness at CIIS Witness ang CDF, at i-cle-clear ang Traveler at ire-release ang pera.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Apat na pirma ang kailangan bago ma-release ang pera.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Walang HBR kung tama ang declaration.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.10 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa clearance at release ng currency kapag tama ang declaration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The first copy of CDF shall be retained and filed at the Arrival Operations Division. The Examiner shall give the second copy to the Traveler or Crew Member. The third copy shall be transmitted to the AMLC.

ai.title: Distribution ng CDF
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Unang kopya sa Arrival Operations Division, pangalawa sa Traveler o Crew Member, pangatlo sa AMLC.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Tatlong kopya, tatlong tatanggap.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Napupunta sa AMLC ang ikatlong kopya para sa monitoring.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.11 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa distribution ng tatlong kopya ng CDF. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Examiner shall input a digital entry in the eTravel Customs System and encode the details of the currency declaration in behalf of the Traveler or Crew Member.

ai.title: Digital Entry
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Examiner ang mag-e-encode ng details ng currency declaration sa eTravel Customs System para sa Traveler o Crew Member.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kahit papel ang ginamit, ipapasok pa rin ito sa system ng Examiner.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ginagawa ito 'in behalf of' ng Traveler.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.12 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa digital entry ng currency declaration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the passenger did not make any foreign currency declaration, but after examination of the baggage and counting of the currency an amount in excess of USD10,000 is found, the USD10,000 or its equivalent shall be returned and the excess amount shall be held in the In-Bond Room of the Baggage Assistance Division and HBR shall be issued to the Traveler or Crew Member.

ai.title: Hindi Idineklara pero Lampas USD10,000
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung walang declaration pero may nakitang lampas USD10,000, ibabalik ang USD10,000 at ang sobra ay ilalagay sa In-Bond Room, at bibigyan ng HBR.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang sobra lang ang hahawakan ng Customs.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ibabalik ang USD10,000 o katumbas.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.13 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa hindi idineklarang foreign currency na lampas USD10,000. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: In case there is a discrepancy between the declared amount of foreign currency and that which is found after counting due to false declaration, the total amount declared shall be returned to the Traveler or Crew Member and the undeclared amount shall be held in the In-Bond Room of the Baggage Assistance Division and HBR shall be issued to the Traveler or Crew Member.

ai.title: Discrepancy sa Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung may diperensya dahil sa false declaration, ibabalik ang kabuuang idineklara at ang hindi idineklara ay ilalagay sa In-Bond Room, at bibigyan ng HBR.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Halimbawa, nag-declare ka ng USD11,000 pero USD15,000 pala: ibabalik ang USD11,000 at hahawakan ang USD4,000.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang undeclared amount lang ang hawak.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.14 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa discrepancy ng idineklara at aktwal na foreign currency. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If fraud is apparent in the false declaration or non-declaration, such as concealment of the undeclared amount or there was an attempt on the part of the Traveler or Crew Member to avoid customs examination or clearance, the Traveler or Crew Member shall be turned over to the ESS for investigation. In the absence of fraud, the Traveler or Crew Member shall be cleared.

ai.title: Fraud sa Currency Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung halata ang fraud, gaya ng pagtatago ng undeclared amount o pag-iwas sa examination, ipapasa ang Traveler sa ESS para sa investigation. Kung walang fraud, i-cle-clear siya.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang false declaration na walang fraud ay hindi automatic na kaso.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Fraud ang pagkakaiba ng investigation at clearance.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.15 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa fraud sa false declaration o non-declaration ng currency. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the Traveler or Crew Member declares in the e-CDF or verbally declares that he is carrying Philippine currency or monetary instruments in excess of PhP 50,000.00, the Examiner shall require the submission of prior authorization from the BSP.

ai.title: BSP Authorization para sa Peso
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag idineklara na may dalang Philippine currency o instruments na lampas PhP 50,000.00, hihingin ng Examiner ang prior authorization ng BSP.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kailangan mo ng permiso ng BSP bukod sa e-CDF.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Para sa Philippine currency ito.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.16 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa BSP prior authorization para sa Philippine currency na lampas PhP 50,000. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: In case of non-declaration of Philippine currency in excess of PhP50,000.00, whether written or verbal, the Philippine currency shall be held in the In-Bond Room of the Baggage Assistance Division and HBR shall be issued to the Traveler or Crew Member.

ai.title: Non-Declaration ng Philippine Currency
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung hindi idineklara ang Philippine currency na lampas PhP50,000.00, nakasulat man o pasalita, ilalagay ito sa In-Bond Room at bibigyan ng HBR.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang Philippine currency na hindi idineklara ay hahawakan ng Customs.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ihambing sa 6.7.13: dito 'the Philippine currency' ang hawak, hindi lang ang sobra.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.17 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa non-declaration ng Philippine currency na lampas PhP50,000. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If evidence of fraud exists, such as concealment or attempt to avoid customs examination and clearance, the Traveler and Crew Member shall be turned over to the ESS for investigation.

ai.title: Fraud: Turn Over sa ESS
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung may ebidensya ng fraud, gaya ng concealment o pag-iwas sa examination at clearance, ipapasa ang Traveler at Crew Member sa ESS para sa investigation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa ESS ang kaso kapag may ebidensya ng fraud.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kasunod ito ng 6.7.15 at para sa Philippine currency.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.7.18 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pag-turn over sa ESS kapag may fraud. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The procedure provided under the preceding section shall likewise apply to the counting, release, or holding in bond of Philippine currency.

ai.title: Parehong Procedure sa Philippine Currency
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang procedure sa naunang section ay ina-apply din sa counting, release o pag-hold in bond ng Philippine currency.

paragraphs.text: Clearance of Restricted, Regulated, or Prohibited Goods.

paragraphs.text: Travelers or Crew Members bringing in restricted or regulated goods shall be required to present/submit the original copy of the import clearances/licenses/permits from the concerned regulatory agency. Upon submission of the verified permits/licenses/clearances, the Traveler and Crew Member shall be cleared, and the goods shall be released, subject to payment of duties, taxes, and other charges, if applicable.

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.8.1 ng CMO 17-2023 tungkol sa pagsumite ng original permit para sa restricted o regulated goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the Traveler or Crew Member fails to submit the required import clearances/licenses/permits, the restricted or regulated goods shall be held in the In-Bond Room of the Baggage Assistance Division and HBR shall be issued to the Traveler or Crew Member. If evidence of fraud exists, such as concealment or attempt to avoid customs examination and clearance, the latter shall be turned over to the ESS for investigation. In the case of regulated perishable goods, such as fruits, vegetables, raw meat, they shall immediately be turned over to the concerned regulatory agency without issuance of HBR.

ai.title: Walang Permit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung walang naisumiteng permit, ilalagay ang goods sa In-Bond Room at bibigyan ng HBR. Kung may fraud, ipapasa ang Traveler sa ESS. Ang regulated perishable goods ay agad ibibigay sa regulatory agency nang walang HBR.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang prutas, gulay at karne ay hindi iho-hold; diretso agad sa agency.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Walang HBR para sa regulated perishable goods.

paragraphs.text: Prohibited goods shall be immediately held in the In-Bond Room of the Baggage Assistance Division and HBR shall be issued to the Traveler or Crew Member. The Traveler or Crew Member shall be turned over to the ESS for investigation.

ai.title: Prohibited Goods
ai.content:

paragraphs.text: The same procedure for examination, inventory of the goods, assessment and payment of duties, taxes and other charges, if applicable shall be done in case of regulated, restricted or prohibited goods.

paragraphs.text: The HBR is an accountable form bearing a serial number which is issued by the warehouseman of the In-Bond Section, Baggage Assistance Division to the Traveler or Crew Member whose baggage is held for any of the following reasons:

sections.heading: Section 7. Procedure for Departing Travelers and Crew Members

paragraphs.text: For departing Travelers and Crew Members which shall take out of the Philippines:

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: Foreign currency, as well as other foreign currency-denominated bearer money instruments, in excess of USD10,000 or its equivalent; and/or

paragraphs.text: The e-CDF should be accomplished in the eTravel Customs System within 72 hours before departure from all airports and seaports of entry by logging in at https://etravel.gov.ph/.

paragraphs.text: In addition to the e-CDF, a prior written authorization duly issued by the BSP should be uploaded by Travelers and Crew Members taking out from the Philippines, legal tender Philippine notes and coins, checks, money order and other bills of exchange drawn in pesos against banks operating in the Philippines in an amount Php50,000.00.

subject: Liquidation and Billing System (LBS) at Post Entry Modification of SAD (PMS) ng LBD
effectivity: This Order shall take effect five (5) days after its posting in the official website of the Bureau.

ai.title: CMO 09-2022 Overview
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CMO 09-2022 ay guidelines sa liquidation ng Goods Declaration for Consumption gamit ang Liquidation and Billing System (LBS), at sa Post Entry Modification of SAD (PMS) na ginagawa ng Liquidation and Billing Division (LBD) o equivalent unit.

🔍 Breakdown: Sec. 1 Scope; Sec. 2 Objectives; Sec. 3 Definition of Terms; Sec. 4 General Provisions (pre-requisites ng PMS, exemptions, 48-hour na proseso); Sec. 5 Operational Provisions under LBS (assignment, findings, Notice of Discrepancy, Final Demand Letter, tagging); Sec. 6 Operational Provisions under PMS (PEMF, Risk Codes, Order of Payment, Clearance Certificate); Sec. 7 hanggang 11 ay Penal, ICT, Repealing, Separability at Effectivity.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pagkatapos ma-release ang goods at mabayaran ang duties, tinitingnan ulit ng LBD kung tama ang computation. Kung may kulang, magpapadala sila ng Notice of Discrepancy, at kung hindi sumagot, Final Demand Letter. paragraphs.text: Once the right values have been encoded, a computation for the additional fees can be seen in the Summary portion of the portal. Additional comments can also be written in the Remarks section. Clicking the Submit button shall save the work done by the assessor.

ai.title: Summary, Remarks at Submit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagkatapos ma-encode ang tamang values, makikita ang computation ng additional fees sa Summary portion. Puwede ring magsulat ng comments sa Remarks, at ang pagpindot sa Submit ay magse-save ng ginawa ng assessor.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Encode, tingnan ang Summary, magdagdag ng Remarks kung kailangan, at Submit para ma-save.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang Summary ang nagpapakita ng computation, ang Remarks ay para sa comments, at ang Submit ang nagse-save.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang closing paragraph ng Sec. 5.7.2 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa Summary, Remarks at Submit. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Once the findings are submitted, the status of the liquidation process shall be reflected as “For Review/Revise”.

ai.title: Status: For Review/Revise
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag naisumite na ang findings, ang status ng liquidation process ay magiging 'For Review/Revise'.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hudyat ito na ang Chief, LBD naman ang magre-review ng gawa ng assessor.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Eksaktong status na ito ang lalabas pagkatapos ng submission ng findings.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.7.3 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa status na For Review/Revise. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Once the status of the Goods Declaration is displayed, the LBD Chief shall check the veracity of the computation for the additional fees done by the assessors. If there are changes needed, the chief can either revise the computation himself or assign it back to the assessor to recompute by clicking the Update button in the Action column.

ai.title: Review ng Chief, LBD
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Titingnan ng LBD Chief kung tama ang computation ng additional fees ng assessors. Kung may kailangang baguhin, puwede niyang siya mismo ang magrebisa o ibalik sa assessor para i-recompute gamit ang 'Update' button sa Action column.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang Chief ang nagsisilbing second-level check sa computation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dalawa ang opsyon ng Chief: siya ang magrebisa, o ibalik sa assessor sa pamamagitan ng Update button.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.8 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa review ng Chief, LBD sa computation. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If there is no discrepancy upon review of the Goods Declaration, the Chief, LBD shall tag the Goods Declaration as “ACCEPTED”.

ai.title: Tag na ACCEPTED
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag walang discrepancy sa review ng Goods Declaration, ita-tag ito ng Chief, LBD bilang 'ACCEPTED'.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Walang kulang, kaya walang sisingilin. Accepted na ang declaration.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang Chief, LBD ang nagta-tag ng status na ito.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.9 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa tag na ACCEPTED. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the computation for additional duties, taxes, and other charges are fully ascertained, the Chief, LBD shall create a templated Notice of Discrepancy which will contain the summary of fees to be paid with the name of the consignee. The Chief, LBD shall click the dropdown list in the Action Column to download the Notice of Discrepancy form which can be digitally signed by the chief before serving it to the consignee.

ai.title: Paggawa ng Notice of Discrepancy
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag tiyak na ang computation ng additional duties, taxes at charges, gagawa ang Chief, LBD ng templated Notice of Discrepancy na may summary ng fees at pangalan ng consignee. Dina-download ito sa dropdown list ng Action Column at maaaring digitally signed ng chief bago i-serve sa consignee.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag final na ang computation, gagawa ng notice sa LBS, pipirmahan ng Chief, at ibibigay sa consignee.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dapat 'fully ascertained' muna ang computation. Digital signature ng chief ang binabanggit.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.10 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa paggawa ng Notice of Discrepancy. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The initiatory Notice of Discrepancy issued by the LBD shall be sent through the registered emails of the concerned accredited importer, or through registered mails or personal service.

ai.title: Paraan ng Pagpapadala ng Notice
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang initiatory Notice of Discrepancy ay ipapadala sa registered emails ng accredited importer, o sa registered mails, o sa personal service.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Tatlong paraan ang pagpapadala: registered email, registered mail, o personal service.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Registered emails ng accredited importer ang binabanggit, hindi kahit anong email address.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang closing paragraph ng Sec. 5.10 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa paraan ng pagpapadala ng Notice of Discrepancy. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the consignee did not answer after fifteen (15) days from receipt of the Notice of Discrepancy, the Chief, LBD shall download a templated Final Demand Letter which can be selected in the dropdown list in the Action Column. The Final Demand Letter shall contain a summary of the fees to be paid and the expected consequence if the demand remains unheeded. The Final Demand Letter shall be signed by the District Collector or by the Chief, LBD as authorized signatory.

ai.title: Final Demand Letter
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag hindi sumagot ang consignee pagkalipas ng 15 araw mula sa pagtanggap ng Notice of Discrepancy, magda-download ang Chief, LBD ng templated Final Demand Letter sa dropdown ng Action Column. May summary ito ng fees at ng inaasahang consequence kung hindi pansinin, at pipirmahan ng District Collector o ng Chief, LBD bilang authorized signatory.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Walang sagot sa loob ng 15 araw, kaya Final Demand Letter ang kasunod.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Bilang ng 15 days ay mula sa receipt ng Notice. Dalawa ang puwedeng pumirma: District Collector o Chief, LBD.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.11 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa Final Demand Letter. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the consignee still refuses to answer the Final Demand Letter, the Chief, LBD shall tag the Goods Declaration as “Delinquent”.

ai.title: Tag na Delinquent (Walang Sagot)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag patuloy na tumatanggi ang consignee na sumagot sa Final Demand Letter, ita-tag ng Chief, LBD ang Goods Declaration bilang 'Delinquent'.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Walang sagot kahit sa Final Demand Letter, kaya Delinquent ang status.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ibang sitwasyon ito sa 5.16, kung saan sumagot pero ayaw magbayad.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.12 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa tag na Delinquent. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The importer shall answer the Notice of Discrepancy or Final Demand Letter by opening a new ticket in the Customer Care Portal System (CCPS) by selecting under the Help Topic “Liquidation and Billing Division: Notice of Discrepancy/Final Demand Letter and PMS” to communicate to the LBD its answer or explanation, or its willingness to pay additional duties, taxes and other charges as indicated in the Notice of Discrepancy/Final Demand Letter.

ai.title: Sagot ng Importer sa CCPS
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sasagot ang importer sa Notice of Discrepancy o Final Demand Letter sa pamamagitan ng pagbubukas ng bagong ticket sa CCPS, at pagpili ng Help Topic na 'Liquidation and Billing Division: Notice of Discrepancy/Final Demand Letter and PMS', para ipaalam sa LBD ang sagot o paliwanag, o ang pagpayag magbayad.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Online ticket sa CCPS ang paraan ng pagsagot, hindi basta email.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tandaan ang eksaktong Help Topic. Puwedeng sagot, paliwanag, o pagpayag magbayad ang laman ng ticket.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.13 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa pagsagot ng importer sa notice gamit ang CCPS. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Upon receipt of the ticket, the Customs Operations Officer IV (COO IV) assigned shall acknowledge the receipt thereof and request the importer to submit additional documents to support its declaration, or in case of PMS, the COO IV shall inform the importer that PMS shall be made of the goods declaration subject of the Notice of Discrepancy/Final Demand Letter.

ai.title: Gawain ng COO IV
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagkatanggap ng ticket, ia-acknowledge ito ng assigned COO IV at hihilingin sa importer ang karagdagang dokumento para suportahan ang declaration. Kung PMS, ipapaalam ng COO IV na gagawin ang PMS sa goods declaration na subject ng Notice of Discrepancy/Final Demand Letter.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dalawa ang posibleng ruta: humingi ng dagdag na dokumento kung nagpapaliwanag ang importer, o ipaalam ang PMS kung papayag itong magbayad.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: COO IV ang tumatanggap ng ticket at nag-a-acknowledge.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.14 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa gawain ng COO IV pagkatanggap ng ticket. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the reviewing officer finds that the justification or explanation is without merit, the importers shall be notified the amount stated in the Notice of Discrepancy/Final Demand Letter.

ai.title: Walang Merit ang Paliwanag
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag nakita ng reviewing officer na walang merit ang justification o paliwanag, ipapaalam sa importer ang halagang nakasaad sa Notice of Discrepancy/Final Demand Letter.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi tinanggap ang paliwanag, kaya ang orihinal na halaga pa rin ang sisingilin.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang halagang ipapaalam ay ang nasa Notice o Final Demand Letter.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.15 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa paliwanag na walang merit. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the importer still refuses to pay the amount, the Chief, LBD shall tag the status of the Goods Declaration as “Delinquent” and shall recommend further action to the District Collector to collect the same.

ai.title: Delinquent: Ayaw Magbayad
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung ayaw pa ring magbayad ng importer, ita-tag ng Chief, LBD ang status bilang 'Delinquent' at magrerekomenda ng karagdagang aksyon sa District Collector para makolekta ang halaga.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ayaw magbayad, kaya Delinquent, at ang District Collector ang magpapasya ng susunod na hakbang.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hindi binanggit sa Order kung ano ang eksaktong further action, kaya huwag mag-assume.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.16 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa Delinquent status kapag ayaw magbayad ng importer. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the consignee settles the obligation, the Chief, LBD shall tag the Goods Declarations as “Paid”, subject to compliance with the procedure for PMS as provided herein.

ai.title: Tag na Paid
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag nabayaran ng consignee ang obligasyon, ita-tag ng Chief, LBD ang Goods Declarations bilang 'Paid', basta nasunod ang procedure para sa PMS ayon sa Order.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bayad na at nasunod ang PMS procedure, kaya Paid na.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: May kondisyon ito: compliance sa PMS procedure (Sec. 6).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.17 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa tag na Paid. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the consignee was able to justify or substantiate the accuracy of the declaration submitted to the Assessment Division, the Chief, LBD shall tag the Notice of Discrepancy/Final Demand Letter as “Cancelled”.

ai.title: Tag na Cancelled
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung napatunayan ng consignee ang accuracy ng declaration na isinumite sa Assessment Division, ita-tag ng Chief, LBD ang Notice of Discrepancy/Final Demand Letter bilang 'Cancelled'.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Napatunayang tama ang declaration, kaya kinakansela ang notice.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang Notice o Final Demand Letter ang ita-tag na 'Cancelled', hindi ang Goods Declaration.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 5.18 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa tag na Cancelled. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Upon receipt of the letter from the importer indicating its willingness to pay the duties, taxes and other charges, the LBD shall properly accomplish the Post Entry Modification Form (PEMF) for approval of the District Collector.

ai.title: PEMF para sa Approval
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagkatanggap ng sulat ng importer na nagsasabing handa itong magbayad, sasagutan ng LBD ang Post Entry Modification Form (PEMF) para sa approval ng District Collector.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pumayag ang importer, kaya ihahanda ng LBD ang PEMF at ipapa-approve sa District Collector.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang District Collector ang nag-a-approve ng PEMF.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.1 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa PEMF at approval ng District Collector. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Upon approval by the District Collector of the PEMF, the assigned LBD Assessor shall perform the PMS to reflect the changes to be made and should properly accomplish the Inspection Act including the filling out of the Risk Code in the E2M customs system.

ai.title: Pagsasagawa ng PMS
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagkatapos aprubahan ng District Collector ang PEMF, gagawin ng assigned LBD Assessor ang PMS para i-reflect ang mga pagbabago, at sasagutan ang Inspection Act kasama ang Risk Code sa E2M.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Approved ang PEMF, kaya ia-update ng assessor ang entry at ilalagay ang Risk Code.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Bahagi ng PMS ang pagsagot sa Inspection Act at pagpuno sa Risk Code.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.2 ng CMO 09-2022 tungkol sa pagsasagawa ng PMS ng LBD Assessor. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: For this purpose and in order to ensure an effective feedback mechanism, the LBD Supervising Customs Assessor shall determine the level of risk using the following Risk Codes:

ai.title: Risk Codes: Layunin
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Para sa feedback mechanism, ang LBD Supervising Customs Assessor ang tutukoy ng level of risk gamit ang mga Risk Code sa susunod na talahanayan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang Risk Codes ay mga code na naglalarawan kung anong uri ng adjustment ang nangyari.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang LBD Supervising Customs Assessor ang tumutukoy ng level of risk.

paragraphs.text: The LBD shall prepare the Order of Payment and forward the same to the importer through the CCPS.

paragraphs.text: The importer settles the amount due immediately (Cash or Manager's Check) thru in-house bank using the Cash-SAD Module of the E2M to reflect the payment in the system.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa in-house bank magbabayad ang importer, at ang Cash-SAD Module ang magpapakita ng payment sa system.

paragraphs.text: Upon payment, the importer shall upload the copy of the BCOR in the CCPS as proof of payment.

ai.title: CMO 09-2021: Express Shipments
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CMO 09-2021 ang nag-i-implement ng CAO 05-2020. Dito nakasaad ang guidelines sa accreditation ng Air Express Cargo Operators (AECO) at sa customs clearance ng express shipments na pumapasok, lumalabas, o nagta-transship sa Pilipinas.

🔍 Breakdown: Sec. 1–3: objectives, definitions, at customs control. Sec. 4–6 (Title I): accreditation ng AECO, customs office sa loob ng AECO facility, at security deposit. Sec. 7–14 (Title II, Ch. 1–2): categories, pre-clearance, at clearance procedures kada category. Sec. 15–16 (Ch. 3): payment at release prior to payment. Sec. 17 (Ch. 4): export clearance. Sec. 18–20 (Ch. 5): exclusions at exceptional circumstances. Sec. 21–24 (Ch. 6): transshipment, abandoned shipments, split consignments, at mis-sorted shipments. Sec. 25–28: transitory, repealing, separability, at effectivity.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Isipin mo ang mga courier parcel na kailangan ng mabilis na delivery. May customs control pa rin, pero risk-based. 'Mas mababa ang value at risk, mas mabilis ang processing.' Kaya hinati sa 4 categories: Correspondence and Documents, De Minimis, Low-Value Dutiable, at High-Value.

📦 Halimbawa: Isang MAWB na naka-consign sa AECO ang may 300 HAWB. Ipinasa ng AECO ang e-CIFCM bago lumipad ang eroplano. Ang parcel na Php8,000 FOB ay de minimis, ang Php30,000 ay dutiable sa informal entry, at ang Php60,000 ay high-value kaya regular clearance.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Ito ang rulebook ng express at courier cargo na isa sa pinaka-busy na parte ng operasyon ng BOC. Madalas lumalabas sa exam ang thresholds at timelines.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Thresholds: de minimis Php10,000 pababa; low-value dutiable lampas Php10,000 pero below Php50,000; high-value Php50,000 pataas. Security deposit ng AECO: hindi bababa sa Php5,000,000.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: Memorize ang cut-off times: 1 hour (Asia) at 4 hours (ibang continent) para sa e-IFCM, 2 hours bago umalis ang aircraft para sa pre-clearance, 6 hours para sa review ng examiner, at 48 hours para sa transshipment.

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Tanong: Pareho ba ang low-value dutiable at high-value? Sagot: Hindi. Ang low-value dutiable ay informal entry (lampas Php10,000 pero below Php50,000), habang ang high-value (Php50,000 pataas) ay sa regular customs cargo clearance procedures.

🔗 Related Topics: CAO 05-2020, CMTA Sec. 102, 402 at 423, CAO 12-2019 (Transshipment), CMO 06-2020 (Informal Entry), RA 6969, RA 10697.

ai.content:

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.5.1 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa Admission. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Consumption — shall refer to goods entered for domestic or local use;

ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Consumption ay para sa goods na ipinasok para sa domestic o lokal na gamit.

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.5.2 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa Consumption. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Transit — shall refer to the customs procedure under which goods, in its original form, are transported under customs control from one customs office to another, or to a free zone;

ai.title: Clearance: Transit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Transit ay customs procedure kung saan ang goods, sa original form, ay dinadala sa ilalim ng customs control mula sa isang customs office papunta sa isa pa, o sa free zone.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Gumagalaw ang goods sa loob ng bansa pero nasa customs control pa rin at hindi pa tuluyang cleared.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dapat nasa 'original form' ang goods habang nasa transit.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.5.3 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa Transit. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Transshipment — shall refer to the customs procedure under which goods are transferred under customs control from the importing means of transport to the exporting means of transport within the area of one customs office, which is the office of both importation and exportation. For purposes of this Order, it also includes transit of transshipment goods from port of entry to another port of entry as exit point for outright exportation; or

ai.title: Clearance: Transshipment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Transshipment ay paglilipat ng goods sa ilalim ng customs control mula sa importing means of transport papunta sa exporting means of transport sa loob ng isang customs office na both importation at exportation office. Kasama rin dito ang transit ng transshipment goods papunta sa ibang port of entry bilang exit point.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Lilipat lang ng eroplano o barko ang cargo, hindi ito papasok sa commerce ng Pilipinas.

ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Connector clause na naglilista ng apat na galaw o proseso na sakop ng transshipment.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: Transfer — shall refer to the transit of transshipment goods under customs control from one port of entry to another port of entry for onward shipment to a destination outside of the Philippines.

ai.title: Transfer
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Transfer ay transit ng transshipment goods sa ilalim ng customs control mula sa isang port of entry papunta sa isa pa para ipadala sa destination sa labas ng Pilipinas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Lilipat ang cargo sa ibang port ng Pilipinas bago tuluyang umalis ng bansa.

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: Transhold — shall refer to the arrival and departure of shipments in the same port of entry on the same transporting vessel or aircraft without unloading or sortation.

ai.title: Transhold
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Transhold ay pagdating at pag-alis ng shipments sa parehong port of entry, sakay ng parehong vessel o aircraft, na walang unloading o sortation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi ibinababa ang cargo. Dumaan lang ang eroplano at tuloy ang biyahe.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.5.4 (b) ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa Transhold. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: c.
paragraphs.text: Transload — shall refer to the process of transferring a shipment from one mode of transportation to another within the same port of entry.

ai.title: Transload
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Transload ay paglilipat ng shipment mula sa isang mode of transportation papunta sa isa pa sa loob ng iisang port of entry.

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.5.4 (c) ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa Transload. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: d.
paragraphs.text: Transsort — shall refer to the unloading, sortation, and reloading of goods, in one continuous process within the same port of entry.

ai.title: Transsort
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Transsort ay pag-unload, sortation, at pag-reload ng goods sa isang tuloy-tuloy na proseso sa loob ng iisang port of entry.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ibinababa at sine-sort ang cargo, tapos isinasakay ulit agad. Ang 'sort' ang pinagkaiba nito sa Transhold.

paragraphs.text: Warehousing — shall refer to the customs procedure under which goods are entered and stored under security in an accredited Customs Bonded Warehouse (CBW).

ai.title: Clearance: Warehousing
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Warehousing ay customs procedure kung saan ang goods ay ipinapasok at iniimbak nang may security sa isang accredited Customs Bonded Warehouse (CBW).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi pa binabayaran ang duties dahil nakaimbak ang goods sa bonded warehouse.

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.5.5 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa Warehousing. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: De Minimis Value — shall refer to the value of goods for which no duty or tax is collected.

ai.title: Definition: De Minimis Value
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang De Minimis Value ay halaga ng goods na hindi kinokolektahan ng duty o tax.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sobrang baba ng halaga kaya libre sa duties at taxes.

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.6 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa De Minimis Value. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Express Shipments — shall refer to consolidated air shipments of goods which are time-sensitive in character, usually under a door-to-door service arrangement with on-time delivery commitment, which are shipped under a MAWB consigned to an AECO.

ai.title: Definition: Express Shipments
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Express Shipments ay consolidated air shipments na time-sensitive, kadalasang door-to-door na may on-time delivery commitment, at ipinapadala sa ilalim ng MAWB na naka-consign sa AECO.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lahat ng air cargo ay express shipment. Kailangan time-sensitive, consolidated, at naka-consign sa AECO.

paragraphs.text: Free Zones — shall refer to special economic zones registered with the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) under Republic Act No. 7916, as amended, duly chartered or legislated special economic zones and freeports such as Clark Freeport Zone; Clark Special Economic Zone, Clark Green City; Poro Point Freeport Zone; John Hay Special Economic Zone and Subic Bay Freeport Zone under Republic Act No. 7227, as amended by Republic Act No. 9400; the Aurora Pacific Economic Zone and Freeport Authority under Republic Act No. 9490, as amended by Republic Act 10083; the Cagayan Special Economic Zone and Freeport under Republic Act No. 7922; the Zamboanga City Special Economic Zone Authority under Republic Act No. 7903; the Freeport Area of Bataan under Republic Act No. 9728; and such other freeports as established or may be created by law.

ai.title: Definition: Free Zones
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Free Zones ay mga special economic zone na rehistrado sa PEZA sa ilalim ng RA 7916, at mga chartered o legislated na economic zone at freeport tulad ng Clark, Poro Point, John Hay, Subic Bay, Aurora, Cagayan, Zamboanga, at Bataan, pati iba pang freeport na itinatag ng batas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mga lugar na may special customs treatment. Hindi pareho ang trato sa kanila at sa 'customs territory'.

paragraphs.text: High-Value Shipments — shall refer to goods of a commercial nature with FOB or FCA value of Fifty Thousand Pesos (Php50,000.00) or over.

ai.title: Definition: High-Value Shipments
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang High-Value Shipments ay commercial goods na may FOB o FCA value na Php50,000.00 pataas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag umabot ng Php50,000 o higit pa, high-value na at hindi na sakop ng informal entry procedure.

paragraphs.text: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) — shall refer to a set of internationally recognized rules which define the responsibility of sellers and buyers. It specifies who is responsible for paying for and managing the shipment, insurance, documentation, customs clearance, and other logistical activities. The following are two (2) of the commonly used Incoterms, among others:

ai.title: Definition: Incoterms
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Incoterms ay internationally recognized rules na nagtatakda ng responsibilidad ng seller at buyer: sino ang magbabayad at mamamahala ng shipment, insurance, documentation, customs clearance, at iba pang logistics.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'hatian ng obligasyon' ng nagbebenta at bumibili sa international trade.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: Free Carrier (FCA) — shall refer to an international commercial term which means that the seller delivers the goods to the carrier or another person nominated by the buyer at the seller’s premises or another named place. The parties of this type of sale should specify clearly as possible the point within the named place of delivery, as the risk passes to the buyer at that point.

ai.title: Incoterm: FCA
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sa FCA, ibinibigay ng seller ang goods sa carrier o taong itinalaga ng buyer sa premises ng seller o sa ibang named place. Sa puntong iyon lumilipat ang risk sa buyer.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang importante ay ang eksaktong lugar ng delivery, dahil doon nagsisimula ang risk ng buyer.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang FCA value ay ginagamit sa pag-classify ng shipments (de minimis, low-value, high-value).

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: Free On-Board (FOB) — shall refer to an international commercial term which means that the seller delivers the goods on board the vessel nominated by the buyer at the named port of shipment or procures the goods already delivered. The risk of loss of or damage to the goods passes when the goods are on board the vessel, and the buyer bears all costs from the moment onwards.

ai.title: Incoterm: FOB
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sa FOB, ibinibigay ng seller ang goods sa loob ng vessel na itinalaga ng buyer sa named port of shipment, o kumukuha ng goods na naihatid na. Lumilipat ang risk kapag nasa loob na ng vessel ang goods, at ang buyer na ang sasagot sa lahat ng gastos mula noon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pagkasakay ng goods sa barko, buyer na ang may panganib at gastos.

paragraphs.text: Low-Value, Dutiable Shipments — shall refer to goods of a commercial nature with FOB or FCA value of more than ten thousand pesos (Php10,000.00) but less than fifty thousand pesos (Php50,000.00).

ai.title: Definition: Low-Value, Dutiable
ai.content:

paragraphs.text: Low-Value, Non-Dutiable — shall refer to the value of goods with an FOB or FCA value of ten thousand pesos (Php10,000.00) or below for which no duty or tax is collected.

ai.title: Definition: Low-Value, Non-Dutiable
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Low-Value, Non-Dutiable ay goods na may FOB o FCA value na Php10,000.00 pababa na walang kinokolektang duty o tax.

paragraphs.text: Package — shall refer to a closed receptacle (i.e. box, carton or envelope) or covering in which the contents of a consignment is packed, ready for shipment or transport.

ai.title: Definition: Package
ai.content:

paragraphs.text: Prohibited Goods — shall refer to the following goods, the importation and exportation of which are prohibited:

ai.content:

ai.content:

paragraphs.text: Written or printed goods, negatives or cinematographic films, photographs, engravings, lithographs, objects, paintings, drawings or other representation of an obscene or immoral character;

ai.title: Prohibited: Obscene o Immoral Materials

📖 Kahulugan: Bawal ang written o printed goods, negatives, pelikula, photographs, engravings, lithographs, objects, paintings, drawings, o ibang representasyon na obscene o immoral ang karakter.

ai.content:

paragraphs.text: Regulated Goods — shall refer to goods, the importation and exportation of which are subject to regulation and shall only be allowed after securing the necessary clearances, licenses, and any other requirements, prior to importation or exportation. ai.title: Definition: Regulated Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Regulated Goods ay goods na puwedeng i-import o i-export pero may regulasyon. Papayagan lamang matapos makakuha ng clearances, licenses, at ibang requirements bago ang importation o exportation.

sections.heading: Section 3. Customs Control over Express Shipments

paragraphs.text: Nothing in this Order shall affect the right of a Bureau to examine, detain, seize, confiscate or refuse entry of goods, or to carry out post-clearance audits, including the use of risk management systems. 💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Tatlo ang nakalista sa 10.3.1 hanggang 10.3.3.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang intro ng listahan sa Sec. 10.3 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa technical problems. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Computer systems breakdown;

ai.title: Technical Problem: System Breakdown
ai.content:

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi gumagana ang system ng BOC o ng AECO.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.3.1 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa computer systems breakdown. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Power failure (which renders the computer system non-operational); or

ai.title: Technical Problem: Power Failure
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Power failure na nagpapahinto sa computer system.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Brownout lang ang technical problem kapag hindi na gumagana ang computer system.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.3.2 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa power failure bilang technical problem. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Payment System of the Philippine Clearing House/Authorized Agent Bank is offline.
