ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Offline ang Payment System ng Philippine Clearing House o Authorized Agent Bank.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi makabayad online ang importer kahit tama ang proseso.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.3.3 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa offline na payment system bilang technical problem. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The following are considered non-technical problems, insofar as applicable to air shipments:

ai.title: Non-Technical Problems
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Intro sa mga itinuturing na non-technical problems, hanggang saan lang applicable sa air shipments.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mga aberyang hindi sira ng system kundi problema sa lokasyon, ownership, o release message.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tatlo ang nakalista sa 10.4.1 hanggang 10.4.3.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.4 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa non-technical problems sa air shipments. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The declared location of goods is incorrect, but the arrastre/transit shed facility confirmed ownership even if the goods is not in their facility;

ai.title: Maling Location, Kinumpirma ng Facility
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Mali ang declared location ng goods, pero kinumpirma ng arrastre o transit shed facility na kanila ito kahit wala sa facility nila.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mali ang address ng goods sa papel, pero inaako pa rin ng facility.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.4.1 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa maling declared location na kinumpirma ng facility. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The declared location of the goods is correct, but the arrastre/transit shed facility denied ownership and misrouted the goods; or

ai.title: Tamang Location, Itinanggi ng Facility
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Tama ang declared location, pero itinanggi ng arrastre o transit shed facility ang ownership at na-misroute ang goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Nasa tamang lugar sa papel, pero sinasabi ng facility na hindi sa kanila at napunta sa ibang lugar.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.4.2 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa tamang declared location pero itinanggi ng facility. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Release message not created/transmitted yet even if the importation is already tagged paid, with print-out Statement of Settlement of Duties and Taxes (SSDT) as proof of payment from BOC Assessment.

ai.title: Release Message Hindi Pa Na-Transmit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Hindi pa nalilikha o naipapadala ang release message kahit tagged paid na ang importation at may print-out ng SSDT bilang proof of payment mula sa BOC Assessment.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bayad na pero walang release message, kaya hindi pa mailabas ang goods.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: SSDT = Statement of Settlement of Duties and Taxes.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.4.3 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa release message na hindi pa na-transmit kahit bayad na. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

sections.heading: Section 11. Clearance Procedures Entered under Correspondence and Documents Process

paragraphs.text: The detailed CIFCM for all Correspondence and Documents shall serve as the goods declaration.

ai.title: CIFCM bilang Goods Declaration (Documents)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang detailed CIFCM para sa lahat ng Correspondence at Documents ang magsisilbing goods declaration.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Walang hiwalay na goods declaration. Ang detailed CIFCM na ang declaration.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Para ito sa Category 1: Correspondence and Documents.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa detailed CIFCM bilang goods declaration ng correspondence at documents. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The document processor shall review the CIFCM to ensure that only correspondence and documents are included therein.

ai.title: Review ng Document Processor
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Rerepasuhin ng document processor ang CIFCM para matiyak na correspondence at documents lang ang laman.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Unang filter: dapat puro sulat at dokumento lang ang nasa listahan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Document processor ang unang gumagalaw.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.1 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa review ng document processor sa CIFCM. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the CIFCM are all correspondence and documents, the document processor shall forward the same to the examiner for processing.

ai.title: Forward sa Examiner
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung puro correspondence at documents ang CIFCM, ipapasa ito ng document processor sa examiner para i-process.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Malinis ang listahan, tuloy sa examiner.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.2 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa pagpasa ng CIFCM sa examiner. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Any non-correspondence and non-document or carrier media shall be segregated from Correspondence and Documents for a separate filing.

ai.title: Segregation ng Non-Documents
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang anumang hindi correspondence o document, o carrier media, ay ihihiwalay para sa hiwalay na filing.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi puwedeng isabay ang ibang items sa documents category.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kasama ang 'carrier media' sa ihihiwalay.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa segregation ng non-correspondence at non-document. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The CIFCM which includes non-correspondence and non-document, or carrier media shall be returned to the AECO for amendment by the AECO.

ai.title: Ibabalik sa AECO para sa Amendment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CIFCM na may non-correspondence, non-document, o carrier media ay ibabalik sa AECO para amyendahan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Maling category ang laman, kaya ibabalik at aayusin ng AECO.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.4 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa pagbabalik ng CIFCM sa AECO para sa amendment. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The customs examiner shall only proceed with the clearance upon receipt of the approved amendment of the CIFCM.

ai.title: Hintayin ang Approved Amendment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Magpapatuloy lang ang customs examiner sa clearance kapag natanggap na ang approved amendment ng CIFCM.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Walang clearance hangga't hindi naaprubahan ang amendment.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.5 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa pagtanggap ng approved amendment bago ang clearance. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The amendment shall be approved by the customs appraiser upon the recommendation by the customs examiner who witnessed the non-intrusive scanning of the sealed green courier bag containing Correspondence and Documents.

ai.title: Sino ang Aprubador ng Amendment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang customs appraiser ang mag-aapruba ng amendment batay sa rekomendasyon ng customs examiner na nakasaksi sa non-intrusive scanning ng sealed green courier bag na may laman na Correspondence at Documents.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Examiner ang nagrerekomenda, appraiser ang nag-aapruba.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'Sealed green courier bag' ang lalagyan ng documents.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.6 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa pag-apruba ng amendment ng customs appraiser. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the result of the non-intrusive scanning is negative of suspicious object, the examiner shall open the sealed green courier bag in the presence of the representative of the AECO for physical count to ensure that the number stated in the CIFCM matches with the actual number in the green courier bag and that the consignees’ names appearing in the detailed CIFCM match with the consignees’ names written in the correspondence or documents. In lieu of manual matching, the AECO may provide the Bureau with a practical and automated system to tally items that are sorted and processed.

ai.title: Negative ang Scanning
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung negatibo sa suspicious object ang scanning, bubuksan ng examiner ang sealed green courier bag kasama ang kinatawan ng AECO para sa physical count: tugma ba ang bilang sa CIFCM at ang pangalan ng consignees sa dokumento. Puwedeng magbigay ang AECO ng automated system kapalit ng manual matching.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bibilangin at ima-match ang bilang at pangalan, may kasamang AECO.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Presence ng AECO representative ang kailangan. Puwedeng automated ang matching.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.7 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa proseso kapag negatibo ang non-intrusive scanning. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If there is a suspicious object, the sealed green courier bag shall be opened, and the tagged Correspondence or Document shall be segregated for physical inspection by the examiner in the presence of the representative of the AECO.

ai.title: May Suspicious Object
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung may suspicious object, bubuksan ang sealed green courier bag at ihihiwalay ang tagged Correspondence o Document para sa physical inspection ng examiner, kasama ang kinatawan ng AECO.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Yung may tag lang ang ihihiwalay at bubuksan, may AECO witness.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Presence ng AECO representative sa physical inspection.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.8 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa proseso kapag may suspicious object. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the result of the physical examination is negative, the examiner shall proceed with the matching of the actual number in the green courier bag against the number reflected in the CIFCM and that the consignees’ names appearing in the detailed CIFCM match with the consignees’ names in the correspondence and documents. In lieu of manual matching, the AECO may provide the Bureau with a practical and automated system to tally items that are sorted and processed.

ai.title: Negative ang Physical Exam
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung negatibo ang physical examination, itutuloy ng examiner ang matching ng aktuwal na bilang sa green courier bag laban sa CIFCM, at ng pangalan ng consignees. Puwedeng automated ang matching.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Walang nakitang problema, kaya itutuloy ang bilang at pangalan na matching.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Pareho ng 11.7 ang matching at automated alternative.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.9 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa proseso kapag negatibo ang physical examination. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Upon completion of the matching, the processing for the clearance and release, using the detailed CIFCM as the Goods Declaration shall be approved by the customs appraiser after the customs examiner has fully completed the assessment process.

ai.title: Approval ng Clearance
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagkatapos ng matching, ang processing para sa clearance at release gamit ang detailed CIFCM bilang Goods Declaration ay aaprubahan ng customs appraiser matapos ganap na makumpleto ng customs examiner ang assessment.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Tapos ang matching, tapos ang assessment ng examiner, saka mag-aapruba ang appraiser.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Appraiser ang final approver.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.10 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa approval ng clearance at release ng appraiser. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: When the result of the physical examination is positive, the customs examiner shall segregate the particular Correspondence or Document and shall return the detailed CIFCM to the AECO for amendment through the document processor. However, the customs examiner shall allow the continuation of the processing and release of the cleared Correspondence or Document upon receipt of the application for amendment of the CIFCM.

ai.title: Positive ang Physical Exam
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung positibo ang physical exam, ihihiwalay ng examiner ang partikular na Correspondence o Document at ibabalik ang detailed CIFCM sa AECO para sa amendment via document processor. Magpapatuloy ang processing at release ng cleared na items kapag natanggap ang application for amendment.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Yung may problema lang ang hihiwalay. Tuloy ang release ng malinis.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hindi nahahawa ang malinis na items.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.11 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa proseso kapag positibo ang physical examination. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The amendment shall cover the splitting of the CIFCM as follows: one (1) CIFCM for cleared Correspondence or Document, and another CIFCM for segregated shipment/s. The Bureau shall process and approve the same within twenty-four (24) hours from receipt of the application.

ai.title: Splitting ng CIFCM
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Hahatiin ang CIFCM sa dalawa: isa para sa cleared na Correspondence o Document, at isa para sa segregated shipment/s. Pro-proseso at aaprubahan ito ng Bureau sa loob ng 24 oras mula receipt ng application.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hiwalay na manifest ang malinis at ang may problema.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 24 hours ang deadline ng Bureau.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.12 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa splitting ng CIFCM. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The examiner and the concerned representatives shall proceed with the applicable procedures, including further examination, inventory, and preparation of report or for issuance of WSD. If eventually the subject Correspondence or Document will be released by the Bureau, the AECO shall file the goods declaration using the individual Air Waybill thereof.

ai.title: Further Examination at WSD
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Susundin ng examiner at ng concerned representatives ang applicable procedures: further examination, inventory, report, o pag-issue ng WSD. Kung ire-release ang Correspondence o Document, ang AECO ay mag-file ng goods declaration gamit ang individual Air Waybill.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang segregated items ay may sariling proseso. Kapag nailabas, hiwalay na goods declaration gamit ang individual AWB.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: WSD = Warrant of Seizure and Detention.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.13 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa further examination, WSD, at goods declaration ng segregated items. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Upon receipt of the amended detailed CIFCM from the AECO thru the document processor, the examiner shall proceed with the processing of the clearance and release of the shipments using the amended detailed CIFCM as the Goods Declaration.

ai.title: Clearance gamit ang Amended CIFCM
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag natanggap ng examiner ang amended detailed CIFCM mula sa AECO via document processor, itutuloy niya ang clearance at release gamit ito bilang Goods Declaration.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang amended CIFCM na ang magiging goods declaration.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.14 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa clearance gamit ang amended detailed CIFCM. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

sections.heading: Section 12. Clearance Procedures Entered under De-Minimis or Low-Value, Non-Dutiable Shipments

paragraphs.text: The detailed CIFCM for all De-Minimis shall serve as the Goods Declaration. However, Regulated Goods of De-Minimis value shall be declared separately per House Air Waybill.

ai.title: CIFCM bilang Goods Declaration (De Minimis)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang detailed CIFCM para sa lahat ng De-Minimis ang magsisilbing Goods Declaration. Pero ang Regulated Goods na de-minimis ang halaga ay idedeklara nang hiwalay kada House Air Waybill.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa de minimis, CIFCM na ang declaration. Ang regulated goods, hiwalay ang declaration kada HAWB.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Exception: regulated goods = separate declaration per HAWB.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 12 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa CIFCM bilang goods declaration ng de-minimis shipments. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The AECO shall submit the detailed CIFCM of all De Minimis Shipments with FOB or FCA value of Ten Thousand Pesos or less, two (2) hours before the departure of the aircraft at the country of origin for pre-clearance.

ai.title: Submission para sa Pre-clearance
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Isusumite ng AECO ang detailed CIFCM ng lahat ng De Minimis Shipments (FOB o FCA na Php10,000 o mas mababa) dalawang (2) oras bago umalis ang aircraft sa origin para sa pre-clearance.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kailangang maaga ang CIFCM para ma-pre-clear.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 2 hours bago departure, Php10,000 o mas mababa.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 12.1 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa submission ng detailed CIFCM ng de minimis shipments para sa pre-clearance. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The document processor shall review the detailed CIFCM to ensure that all information required for each shipment to be indicated in the detailed CIFCM are complete. If the information is complete, the document processor shall forward the CIFCM to the examiner for review. If the information is not complete, the document processor shall inform the AECO for amendment.

ai.title: Review ng Completeness
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Titingnan ng document processor kung kumpleto ang impormasyon ng bawat shipment sa detailed CIFCM. Kung kumpleto, ipapasa sa examiner. Kung hindi, ipapaalam sa AECO para sa amendment.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kumpleto = examiner. Kulang = balik sa AECO.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Document processor ang unang gate.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 12.2 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa review ng completeness ng detailed CIFCM. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the CIFCM does not include shipments with value of more than Php10,000.00 or non-regulated, the document processor shall forward the detailed CIFCM to the examiner for clearance.

ai.title: Malinis ang CIFCM
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung walang shipments na lampas Php10,000.00 sa CIFCM, at non-regulated, ipapasa ng document processor ang detailed CIFCM sa examiner para sa clearance.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pasok sa de minimis at hindi regulated = diretso sa examiner.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dalawang kondisyon: hindi lampas Php10,000 at non-regulated.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 12.3 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa pagpasa ng malinis na CIFCM sa examiner. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the CIFCM includes shipments with value of more than Php10,000.00 or includes regulated goods, the document processor shall forward the detailed CIFCM to the AECO for amendment and shall inform the examiner of the same.

ai.title: May Lampas Php10,000 o Regulated
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung may shipment na lampas Php10,000.00 o may regulated goods ang CIFCM, ibabalik ng document processor ang detailed CIFCM sa AECO para sa amendment at ipapaalam sa examiner.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi pang-de minimis ang item na iyon, kaya aayusin ng AECO.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kailangang ipaalam din sa examiner.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 12.4 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa CIFCM na may lampas Php10,000 o regulated goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Upon receipt of the detailed original or amended detailed CIFCM, the examiner shall check the detailed CIFCM against the packages to ensure that the information in the detailed CIFCM match with the information appearing in the package.

ai.title: Checking ng CIFCM vs Packages
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagkatanggap ng original o amended detailed CIFCM, ikukumpara ng examiner ang CIFCM sa mga package para matiyak na tugma ang impormasyon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Titingnan kung ang nakasulat sa manifest ay tugma sa nasa pakete.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Original man o amended ang CIFCM, iche-check pa rin.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 12.5 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa pag-check ng detailed CIFCM laban sa packages. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Once verification is completed, the examiner shall request the BOC-XIP for the scanning of the shipments indicated in the detailed original/amended CIFCM.

ai.title: Request sa BOC-XIP para sa Scanning
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag tapos na ang verification, hihilingin ng examiner sa BOC-XIP ang scanning ng shipments na nakalista sa detailed original o amended CIFCM.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: XIP ang gumagawa ng scanning. Examiner ang humihiling.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: BOC-XIP ang scanning unit.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 12.6 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa request ng examiner sa BOC-XIP para sa scanning. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the result of the scanning is negative of suspicious object, the processing for the clearance and release of the goods shall continue.

ai.title: Negative ang Scanning
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung walang suspicious object sa scanning, tuloy ang clearance at release ng goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Malinis ang scan, tuloy ang proseso.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 12.7 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa negatibong resulta ng scanning. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If there is a suspicious object, the tagged shipment shall be segregated for physical inspection.

ai.title: May Suspicious Object
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung may suspicious object, ihihiwalay ang tagged shipment para sa physical inspection.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Yung may tag lang ang bubuksan.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 12.8 ng CMO 09-2021 tungkol sa tagged shipment na may suspicious object. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the result of the physical examination is negative, the examiner shall proceed with the matching of the actual number and details of the shipments indicated in the detailed CIFCM to ensure that details appearing the Goods Declaration match.

ai.title: Negative ang Physical Exam
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung negatibo ang physical exam, itutuloy ng examiner ang matching ng aktuwal na bilang at detalye ng shipments sa detailed CIFCM para matiyak na tugma ang nasa Goods Declaration.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Walang nakitang problema, kaya i-match na lang ang bilang at detalye.

paragraphs.label: b.

paragraphs.text: The XIP personnel/assigned customs examiner, as the case may be, shall notify the AECO to segregate the particular bag or receptacle containing the held shipment and ensure that the same can be easily retrieved for the physical examination.

paragraphs.text: If no suspected item was found, the appraiser must click the LIFT button in the SAD module of the E2M to allow the continuous processing of the shipment, regardless of whether the physical examination was conducted within or beyond six (6) hours from lodgement.

paragraphs.text: If the examination was conducted within six (6) hours from lodgement and no suspected item was found, the examiner may update the SAD and shall forward the documents to the appraiser for rerouting of the Goods Declaration to Green for further processing and payment.

paragraphs.text: If the actual value of the goods is higher than the declared value, the examiner shall update the SAD and shall forward the documents to the appraiser for further processing.

paragraphs.text: In case the AECO fails to export the same within forty-eight (48) hours from the date of arrival, the AECO can no longer avail of the longer timeframe to submit TFCM or OFCM provided for under Sections 21.1.1. and 21.1.4.
